title: Operations Manager, VP
description:
Join us as an Operations Manager
   

  

* Drive operational performance through effective planning, governance and stakeholder management, making sure the function delivers against priorities, manages risk effectively and continuously improves
* You’ll improve operational service delivery performance by embedding voice of customer feedback, driving continuous improvement across our core colleague lifecycle processes
* Working collaboratively across the four service capabilities, you’ll proactively identify service enhancements and deliver seamless experiences for our colleagues
* We're offering this role at vice president level


 What you’ll do
   

  

 Be the driving force behind improving the colleague experience, shaping smarter services and delivering meaningful change across the end\-to\-end colleague lifecycle. In this pivotal role, you’ll be accountable for driving and delivering service improvement across the end\-to\-end colleague lifecycle from the point at which a colleague onboards to the point they leave the bank.
   

  

**You’ll Also Be**
* Managing a small change backlog, delivery plan and define an engaging comms strategy to seamlessly land enhancements with the business
* Providing leaders with timely insight, analysis, options and recommendations to support operational, investment and prioritisation decisions
* Leveraging colleague feedback, service insights and journey performance data to improve services and enhance experiences across the colleague lifecycle


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 We're looking for an Operations Manager with experience delivering business operations, service management, operational delivery or programme support within a complex organisation.
   

  

 You’ll bring a strong understanding of portfolio management, operational governance, service management, continuous improvement, resource planning and business operations, enabling effective delivery, informed decision\-making and sustainable business performance. You’ll also bring strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build productive relationships across teams, functions and external partners.
   

  

**You’ll Demonstrate**
* The ability to manage competing priorities, stakeholders, suppliers, risks and dependencies while delivering against agreed objectives
* A track record of implementing operational improvements and embedding sustainable change into business\-as\-usual activities
* Strong supplier management capability, including service reviews, performance oversight and relationship management within a controlled environment
* Strong analytical skills, with experience interpreting operational, financial and service performance data to inform decisions and identify improvement opportunities
* Deep expertise in Workday colleague lifecycle processes and their application across the employee journey
* Experience designing and implementing ServiceNow processes
* Deep expertise in service blueprinting and process design

title: Spa Manager
description:
**Role Description** 
 The Spa Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi, responsible for overseeing daily spa operations and ensuring a high\-quality guest experience. This role includes managing staff schedules, supervising spa therapists and front\-desk teams, and maintaining service standards and cleanliness across all spa areas. The Spa Manager will handle budgeting and inventory, monitor revenue and expenses, and implement promotions or packages to support business goals. Day\-to\-day tasks also involve resolving guest concerns, managing bookings, coordinating with other departments, and ensuring adherence to health, safety, and hygiene protocols. The Spa Manager will contribute to training and mentoring staff, supporting a professional, inclusive, and respectful workplace culture.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong spa management and operations skills, including experience supervising spa teams and managing daily workflows.
* Candidates should possess customer satisfaction and customer service skills, with the ability to handle guest feedback and deliver a consistent, high\-quality client experience.
* Candidates should possess budgeting and basic financial management skills, including tracking expenses, managing inventory, and supporting revenue targets.
* Candidates should possess practical knowledge of skin care and spa treatments, enabling effective oversight of service quality and training.
* Relevant experience in spa, wellness, or hospitality management, preferably in a hospital or health care environment.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work in a diverse, inclusive team setting.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends or holidays, as required by spa operations.
* Diploma or degree in spa management, hospitality, wellness, or a related field is preferred.

title: Sr. Manager – Production/Manufacturing | Injectables (Sterile/Non-Sterile) | Min. 7 Years Pharma Manufacturing Experience | CTC up to ₹12 LPA | Bahadurgarh (Delhi NCR)
description:
**Company Description** 
 Jaidev Pharma Placement is a specialized pharma and healthcare recruitment partner, focused on building high\-performing teams that drive sustainable growth and impact. In just five years, the firm has partnered with over 75 organizations across India, supported by a network of more than 350,000 pharma professionals. With over 20 years of industry experience and 5\+ years in recruitment, Jaidev Pharma Placement combines deep sector knowledge with strong talent\-matching capabilities. Headquartered in Gurgaon, with offices in the Mumbai region and Hyderabad, the team of experienced pharma professionals and dynamic recruiters delivers strategic hiring, training, and performance enhancement solutions for roles starting from ₹5 LPA and above.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Sr. Manager – Production/Manufacturing (Injectables, Sterile/Non\-Sterile) will lead and oversee end\-to\-end manufacturing operations for injectable products, ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory standards. This full\-time, on\-site role is based in Bahadurgarh (Delhi NCR), India and involves planning production schedules, optimizing resource utilization, and monitoring throughput to meet targets and timelines. The role includes supervising shop\-floor teams, managing sterile and non\-sterile injectable processes, coordinating with QA, QC, maintenance, and supply chain for smooth operations, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The Sr. Manager will implement and maintain cGMP practices, documentation, and validation activities, handle audits and inspections, and contribute to cost control, efficiency enhancement, and capacity expansion. The position also requires mentoring team members, supporting training, and ensuring adherence to safety protocols and company policies.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong expertise in injectable manufacturing (sterile and non\-sterile), production planning, and shop\-floor supervision in a regulated pharma environment.
* Solid knowledge of cGMP, WHO/GMP, regulatory compliance, quality systems, and documentation practices relevant to injectable manufacturing.
* Experience in process optimization, capacity planning, continuous improvement, and cost\-efficiency initiatives within pharmaceutical plants.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop cross\-functional production teams, with effective people management, coordination, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Minimum 7 years of pharmaceutical manufacturing experience, preferably in injectables, with prior exposure to audits and regulatory inspections.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Science, or a related technical field from a recognized institution.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities, with proficiency in using production\-related tools and basic ERP/MIS systems.
* Excellent communication skills, ability to collaborate with QA, QC, engineering, and supply chain, and readiness to work on\-site in Bahadurgarh (Delhi NCR).

title: School Administrator
description:
**Administration \& Operations Manager** 




*A leadership role for a young, ambitious operator — grow into running an entire campus.* 



**1\.  The Role in One Line** 


 Run the day\-to\-day operation of a growing boarding school — the hostels, the campus, the food, the support staff, the student\-life experience — and lead the team that makes it all work. This is a
 
**stretch role** 

 : we are deliberately looking for someone earlier in their career who is hungry to take on real ownership and grow into a senior operations leader as the school grows.
 



**2\.  About Plenum** 


 Plenum is a future\-focused boarding school in the hills of Himachal Pradesh, nurturing aspirational students into young people of
 
**courage, consistency, capability, compassion, and character** 

 . We combine academic excellence with real\-world skills, supported by technology\-enabled systems, English immersion, and a coaching culture where every adult on campus is a mentor and role model.
 





 We are growing — and we build our operations like a serious institution, with clear systems, routines, and standards rather than jugaad. The person in this role will be central to that.
 



**3\.  Why Join Us: A Call to Adventure** 


 Plenum is more than a workplace — it is a mission, set in the forests and hills of Himachal.
 





 This is a rare chance to run an entire campus operation
 
**far earlier in your career than you would get anywhere else** 

 . You will own real responsibility from day one, lead a team of wardens and support staff, and directly shape the daily life and safety of a residential community of children. If you are ambitious, organised, and want to grow fast into a senior leadership role, this is built for you.
 





 At Plenum, we offer:
 



* Real ownership and decision\-making from the start — not a desk job.
* Regular training, mentorship, and a clear path to grow into senior leadership as the school expands.
* A transparent, supportive, systems\-driven culture.
* Free boarding and food on a beautiful hill campus.



  





  




**4\.  What You Will Own (Responsibilities \& Outcomes)** 


 You will be responsible for the smooth, safe, and warm running of the entire non\-academic campus operation. In practice, that means:
 




**Boarding \& Student Life.** 

 Ensure hostels are clean, disciplined, safe, and cheerful. Oversee daily routines, student wellbeing, and a warm hostel culture where students feel genuinely cared for and fairly treated. Make sure hostel events and celebrations run well.
 




**Team Leadership.** 

 Lead and motivate the residential and support team — wardens, nurse, counsellor, and non\-teaching staff. Set clear expectations, meet them regularly, solve their problems, and build a team that holds high standards because they want to, not because they are forced to.
 




**Food \& Mess Quality.** 

 Oversee kitchen hygiene, food variety and quality, and clean drinking water. Keep student complaints low and push vendors and kitchen staff to keep improving.
 




**Campus Infrastructure \& Maintenance.** 

 Keep classrooms, bathrooms, hostels, and staff housing functional, clean, and teaching\-ready. Solve maintenance problems proactively rather than letting repairs pile up.
 




**Vendors \& Procurement.** 

 Oversee the quality of groceries, cleaning supplies, and repairs. Check deliveries, build reliable vendor relationships, and escalate quality or pricing issues appropriately.
 




**Staff Management \& HR.** 

 Handle staff leave, disputes, and morale with fairness and maturity. Keep the team motivated and the culture healthy.
 




**Student Care Oversight.** 

 Ensure minor illnesses are handled quickly and serious cases are escalated to parents properly, working closely with the nurse and counsellor so no child slips through the cracks.
 




**Culture \& Non\-Negotiables.** 

 Uphold Plenum's values and non\-negotiables — respect, fairness, no bullying, growing English use, consistent discipline — and model them yourself.
 




**Coordination.** 

 Work closely with the finance and academic teams so that budgets, hostel schedules, and study routines all align, and flag risks early to leadership.
 




**What good looks like:** 
*hostels feel warm and run smoothly, students are safe and happy, staff trust and respect you, the campus is well\-maintained, food quality is good, and problems are anticipated and solved before they grow — all with minimal need for top\-down chasing.* 



**5\.  Who We Are Looking For** 
* A graduate with roughly 2–5 years of experience in operations, administration, hospitality, facility/campus management, or a similar hands\-on coordinating role. School or hostel experience is a plus but not essential.
* Genuinely organised and systems\-minded — you like building routines and checklists, and you follow through.
* A natural people\-manager: firm but fair, calm under pressure, able to earn the respect of a team older or more experienced than you.
* Ambitious and hungry to grow — you want responsibility and a path to senior leadership, not a comfortable 9\-to\-5\.
* Warm and student\-centred, with the maturity to help care for a residential community of children.
* Willing to live on campus and be part of boarding\-school life.
* Comfortable using simple digital tools (spreadsheets, WhatsApp, basic trackers) to run operations.


**6\.  Remuneration \& Perks** 
* **Salary:** 

 ₹30,000 – ₹40,000 per month, with scope up to ₹50,000 for an exceptional candidate.
* Free boarding and food on campus.
* Annual bonus pools and performance incentives.
* Ongoing training, mentorship, and a real path to grow into senior leadership as the school expands.


**7\.  Reporting \& How to Apply** 

**Reports to:** 

 Operations (school leadership).
 




**Manages:** 

 Wardens, nurse, counsellor, and non\-teaching / support staff.
 




**For any questions, or to apply directly, contact:** 




**Suman Kumari — Executive Assistant to the CEO** 




**Email: suman.kumari@theplenumschool.edu** 




**WhatsApp: \+91 89498 14841**

title: Senior Manager, Incident & Change Management (ITIL Expertise + Experience in Network, Infra, Data Centre & Application-Support is a Must)
description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a
 **Great Place to Work** 
 ® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job?
   

  

 The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

**About The Role \& Team**
 As Senior Manager, Incident \& Change Management within Digital Customer Operations (DCO), you will lead a global team of Incident and Change Managers responsible for protecting service continuity, governing operational change, and restoring critical services with speed and control. You will combine advanced, hands\-on ITIL expertise with strong operational leadership across network, infrastructure, data centre and application\-support environments. The role is a senior escalation point for complex regional and global services, engaging executives, customers and technical leaders during high\-impact incidents and major changes. You will drive continuous improvement and digitalization, strengthen customer outcomes, and build a high\-performing team aligned with DCO priorities.
   

  

* As per SITA Career Framework the title will be Senior Manager, Service Operations


**What You’ll Do**
 Incident Management
   

  

* Lead and govern the end\-to\-end Incident Management process, ensuring the rapid restoration of critical services while minimizing business and customer impact.
* Act as the senior escalation point for high\-severity incidents, coordinating technical, operational, and business teams to drive timely resolution.
* Lead crisis management activities during service disruptions, providing clear communication and regular updates to executives, customers, and key stakeholders.
* Drive incident response governance, ensuring adherence to ITIL best practices, escalation procedures, and operational controls.
* Monitor and improve incident management KPIs, including service availability, resolution times, service restoration metrics, and customer impact.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and root cause analysis to identify corrective actions and prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with Network, Infrastructure, Data Center, Application Support, and Service Operations teams to strengthen service resilience and operational stability.
* Provide leadership during executive\-level escalations, effectively managing communications with senior management and strategic customers.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance incident response effectiveness, operational performance, and customer experience.


**Change Management**
* Lead and govern the end\-to\-end Change Management process, ensuring all infrastructure, network, application, and service changes are implemented in a controlled and risk\-managed manner.
* Establish and maintain Change Management policies, standards, and governance frameworks in alignment with ITIL best practices.
* Chair Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings, evaluating change risks, business impacts, dependencies, and implementation readiness.
* Ensure changes are assessed, approved, tested, and deployed with minimal disruption to business operations and customer services.
* Monitor change effectiveness through KPIs and reporting, including change success rates, failed changes, emergency changes, and change\-related incidents.
* Partner with operational, engineering, and business teams to balance service stability, operational resilience, and business agility.
* Act as the senior escalation point for high\-risk or business\-critical changes, providing clear communication and decision\-making support to senior stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance change governance, reduce operational risk, and improve service reliability across complex enterprise environments.
* Lead post\-implementation reviews and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into future change planning and execution.


**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**
* Continuous Improvement \& Digitalization: Demonstrated ability to use incident, change, SLA and KPI insights to simplify workflows, strengthen controls, automate repeatable activities and improve operational performance.
* Customer\-Centric Thinking: Proven ability to make service decisions based on customer impact, business criticality and transparent communication, while balancing restoration speed, risk and long\-term service quality.
* Self \& Business Leadership: Strong executive presence, judgement and accountability, with the ability to remain composed during crises, set direction, influence decisions and lead teams through ambiguity and operational pressure.
* Advanced hands\-on expertise in ITIL Service Management, with deep experience across Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, and Service Operations governance.
* Extensive experience leading large\-scale operational environments, ensuring service stability, resilience, and continuous operational excellence.
* Strong leadership, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment and decision\-making across cross\-functional and geographically dispersed teams.
* Proven capability in Major Incident and Crisis Management, including leading the response to critical service disruptions and coordinating recovery efforts within complex enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated experience defining, monitoring, and improving Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to drive operational performance and customer satisfaction.
* Broad technical understanding of enterprise IT environments, including Network Operations, Infrastructure Services, Data Center Operations, and Application Support, enabling effective decision\-making during service\-impacting events.

title: Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation
description:
****COMPANY PROFILE****
 Bain \& Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
   

  

 Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
   

  

 The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
   

  

****WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK****
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top\-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times.
   

  

 Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
   

  

****Position Summary****
 The position is in the CRM Team based at Bain’s GBS office in Gurgaon, New Delhi, and is an integral part of the Global Commercial Operations department. CRM is a key tool for the firm’s frontline leaders in pursuing commercial objectives, including relationship cultivation, opportunity management, and account plan execution. The CRM Team enables this pursuit by enhancing the platform, processes, analytics, and user experience that support effective commercial decision\-making.
   

  

 Under the direction of the CRM Senior Manager, the
 **Manager, CRM Optimization \& Innovation** 
 owns core workstreams within the team, driving projects and initiatives across CRM optimization, innovation, analytics, and automation. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy\-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end\-to\-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision\-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role. In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.
   

  

****Essential Functions:****
**Own projects and initiatives related to advanced analytics**
* Leads a team of data analysts, who are utilizing their advanced technical skills to support complex end user requests that require data to be visualized from multiple sources
* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.
* Evaluate best in market tools and provide solutions which will lead to efficiencies (time savings) as well as automation (advancement) on team’s processes.
* Leads projects and initiatives requests relating to data quality often require quick turnaround time. Collaborate closely with the wider Global CRM team and communicate with the senior stakeholders during various phases of these projects or requests including cross\-functional collaboration.


**Invests comprehensively in continuous development of programs**
* Evaluates current CRM design and propose functional improvements in the system to enhance overall user experience. Articulates clear recommendations on how to improve the interface/processes and thus quality of CRM output.
* Utilizes exceptional communication skills to develop programming and deliver insights. Drives necessary process changes and facilitates brainstorming with impacted stakeholders to get to resolve issues and build consensus. Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation \& Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.


**People Management**
* Oversee day\-to\-day CRM analytics projects. Collaborates with other senior leaders within the New Delhi GBS office to manage oversight of the entire team.
* Works with senior leadership to ensure regular processes and project work do not exceed team capacity
* Daily task oversight and addressing queries as needs arise with a team of 1\-3 direct reports. Provides daily direction as well as ongoing coaching and evaluation of team, including yearly performance reviews and professional development plans.
* Responsible for overseeing the quality of output of the team members. Identifies areas for operational improvement. Proactively resolve problems and escalate issues to the senior leadership, as necessary.
* Leads team in accordance with Bain’s operating principles encouraging optimum performance and an unwavering focus on results. Maintains transparent two\-way communication.
* Plans required staffing levels to maintain required processes and procedures. Teams with HR and senior leadership to recruit, interview and hire employees.
* Demonstrated ability to understand company policies/practices and be able to explain this information and advice and influence an audience that is not knowledgeable in this area of the business


**Qualification**
**Education**
**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration \- Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is required


**Preferred**
* Master’s degree in business administration \- Computer Science, Data Science or a related field is highly preferred


****Experience****
 Required
   

  

* Salesforce experience
* Project management experience is desired, and a formal certification will be an added advantage
* Overall 10\+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems


**Preferred**
* Overall 10\+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems from a professional services environment


**Required**
**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**
- Experience with:

* Salesforce / CRM
* Advanced SQL
* Advanced Alteryx
* Python / ML
* AI / Custom GPT / Agentic AI
* Data Analysis
* Data Research
* Data Integrity
* Data Visualization
* Automation
* Project Management
* Team Leadership
* Able to work closely with teams in other parts of the world, which will require flexible hours.
* Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written language. The candidate must communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and possess a natural intellectual curiosity about Bain’s business.
* Excellent customer management skills to work with internal global clients. We should work with flawless customer service, diligence, and collaboration across internal teams.
* A strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. Analyzes trends and monitors problem areas to identify areas for operational improvement.
* Reliable, consistent and mature and able to work independently with a positive attitude.
* Ability to calmly multitask, and learn quickly in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and develop sustainable solutions to deliver practical results
* Should deepen understanding and knowledge of the consulting industry
* Consistent alignment with Bain’s Operating Principles
* Skilled with advanced Excel and PowerPoint


**Preferred**
* Experience with:
* ServiceNow
* Coaching
* Mentoring
* Training
* Advanced Tableau
* Helpdesk support (email, live user training)

title: Senior Executive / Manager – Golf Events
description:

* Assign responsibilities and monitor completion of event\-related tasks.
* Guide junior team members and on\-ground staff as required.
* Take ownership of operational issues and ensure timely resolution.

* Contribute ideas for innovative golf event formats and participant experiences.
* Ensure consistent brand visibility and sponsor integration across events.
* Monitor participant and client feedback and identify areas for improvement.

* 3\+ years of experience in
 **sports event management** 
 .

* Strong vendor, client, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good communication, negotiation, and coordination abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple events/tasks simultaneously.
* Strong problem\-solving and on\-ground execution skills.
* Basic understanding of event budgeting, costing, and revenue generation.
* Willingness to travel and work flexible hours, including weekends, depending on event requirements.

**What We're Looking For** 



* Someone who understands the
 **golf ecosystem** 
 .
* Strong execution\-oriented approach with the ability to manage both planning and on\-ground operations.

**Compensation:** 
 Up to 7 LPA
 



  





 Interested candidates can share their updated CV at hr@4moles.com.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)(JD-0091)
description:
****Job Overview:****
 Function: Hospital Operations \& Business Leadership
   

  

 Reporting To: Chief Executive Officer
   

  

 Role Level: Executive Leadership
   

  

* ROLE PURPOSE


 The Chief Operating Officer (COO) will be responsible for the overall operational leadership, performance, patient experience, financial performance and sustainable growth of the hospital. The COO will translate the organisation’s vision and strategic objectives into measurable operational outcomes and will provide leadership across clinical support services, nursing, patient services, front office, contact centre, diagnostics, pharmacy, facilities, biomedical engineering, housekeeping, security, procurement, supply chain, HR, IT, quality, patient experience and other hospital functions in close coordination with the Medical Leadership.
   

  

**The COO Will Establish a Culture Of:**
* Patient\-centricity
* Clinical and operational excellence
* Accountability
* Service excellence
* Quality and patient safety
* Financial discipline
* Data\-driven decision making
* Employee engagement
* Continuous improvement


 The role is expected to operate as the integrator between clinical, operational, financial and strategic functions of the hospital.
   

  

* KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES


**Overall Hospital Operations:** 
 Provide overall leadership for the day\-to\-day functioning of the hospital and ensure seamless coordination between clinical and non\-clinical departments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include:**
* Ensure smooth 24×7 hospital operations.
* Establish operating standards across all departments.
* Monitor hospital capacity, patient flow and resource utilisation.
* Drive operational productivity and efficiency.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Establish daily, weekly and monthly operational review mechanisms.
* Ensure timely escalation and closure of operational issues.
* Develop and monitor hospital\-wide SOPs, policies and workflows.
* Ensure operational readiness of new departments, services and facilities.
* Build a culture of ownership and measurable accountability among HODs.
* P\&L AND FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT


 The COO will have strong accountability for the hospital’s financial performance in partnership with the CFO/Finance function.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Develop and execute annual operating plans and budgets.
* Drive revenue growth and profitable utilisation of hospital capacity.
* Monitor EBITDA, revenue, cost and productivity indicators.
* Improve bed occupancy and Average Length of Stay (ALOS).
* Improve OT, ICU, diagnostics and other asset utilisation.
* Monitor ARPOB/ARPP and other relevant hospital financial metrics.
* Control operating expenditure without compromising patient safety or quality.
* Review manpower productivity and departmental cost structures.
* Drive procurement and vendor cost optimisation.
* Monitor revenue leakage and process gaps.
* Review insurance, TPA and corporate business performance.
* Participate in capital expenditure planning and ROI evaluation.
* BUSINESS GROWTH \& HOSPITAL DEVELOPMENT


 Lead initiatives that increase the hospital’s market presence, patient volumes and service portfolio.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Develop hospital growth plans in collaboration with CEO/MD.
* Identify opportunities for new specialties, services and centres of excellence.
* Develop physician engagement and retention strategies.
* Strengthen referral networks.
* Develop corporate, insurance and TPA relationships.
* Support international patient / medical tourism initiatives where applicable.
* Drive outreach, community engagement and healthcare camps.
* Analyse competitor positioning and local market dynamics.
* Develop strategies for improving new\-patient acquisition.
* Improve repeat utilisation and patient retention.
* Support strategic partnerships, alliances and expansion initiatives.
* PATIENT EXPERIENCE \& SERVICE EXCELLENCE


 Make patient experience a measurable hospital\-wide operating discipline.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Establish hospital\-wide patient experience standards.
* Monitor patient satisfaction/NPS/feedback indicators.
* Strengthen Contact Centre, CRM and patient relationship management.
* Establish structured grievance management and escalation mechanisms.
* Ensure complaints are analysed through RCA and CAPA.
* Monitor patient journey across OPD, IPD, Emergency, Diagnostics, Pharmacy and Discharge.
* Reduce waiting times and patient inconvenience.
* Improve communication between patients, attendants and hospital teams.
* Establish service recovery mechanisms for critical complaints.
* Drive mystery audits and patient journey audits.
* Ensure patient feedback is converted into operational improvements.
* CLINICAL OPERATIONS \& PATIENT SAFETY


 The COO will work in close partnership with the Medical Superintendent and Nursing Leadership.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Facilitate coordination between clinical and non\-clinical functions.
* Support implementation of clinical governance frameworks.
* Monitor clinical support processes and operational barriers.
* Ensure availability of critical resources for clinical services.
* Monitor patient safety indicators in partnership with Quality and Medical teams.
* Support incident reporting, RCA and CAPA.
* Ensure timely resolution of operational issues affecting patient care.
* Support implementation and maintenance of NABH/JCI or applicable accreditation standards.
* Ensure emergency preparedness and disaster management systems.
* Monitor infection\-control related operational requirements.
* QUALITY, ACCREDITATION \& COMPLIANCE


 Drive a culture of continuous quality improvement.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Lead operational preparedness for NABH/JCI and other applicable accreditations.
* Ensure departmental compliance with hospital policies.
* Establish compliance dashboards.
* Monitor internal audit findings.
* Ensure timely closure of NCs, observations and CAPAs.
* Strengthen documentation and process adherence.
* Monitor statutory and regulatory compliance in partnership with relevant functions.
* Ensure hospital licences, registrations and statutory requirements are appropriately tracked.
* Establish an organisation\-wide risk management framework.
* Culture \& Organizational Effectiveness


 Build a high\-performance hospital leadership culture.
   

  

* Develop organisational structure and manpower plans.
* Establish productivity norms for departments.
* Participate in recruitment of senior leadership positions.
* Develop performance management systems.
* Establish departmental KPIs and KRAs.
* Drive leadership development and succession planning.
* Monitor employee engagement and attrition.
* Develop accountability mechanisms for HODs.
* Strengthen cross\-functional collaboration.
* Promote a culture of respect, discipline, transparency and patient\-centricity.
* TECHNOLOGY \& DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION


 Lead operational adoption of healthcare technology in partnership with CIO/IT.
   

  

* Ensure effective utilisation of HIS/EMR/CRM platforms.
* Drive digital patient journey initiatives.
* Establish hospital\-wide operational dashboards.
* Promote data\-driven decision making.
* Integrate Contact Centre, CRM, HIS and patient feedback systems.
* Monitor system adoption and data quality.
* Identify opportunities for automation.
* Drive digital registration, appointment, communication and follow\-up initiatives.
* Ensure technology projects deliver measurable operational benefits.
* CONTACT CENTRE \& CRM GOVERNANCE


 The COO will provide executive oversight of patient communication channels.
   

  

* Contact Centre performance
* Appointment conversion.
* Call abandonment.
* Response time.
* Patient Grievance Cell
* Escalation management.
* Outbound campaigns.
* Patient follow\-up.
* CRM utilisation.
* Lead management.
* Doctor/service enquiries.
* Feedback and grievance management.


 The COO should ensure that the Contact Centre operates as a bloodline of the hospital and patient\-access \& service excellence enablement function
   

  

* SUPPLY CHAIN, PROCUREMENT \& VENDOR MANAGEMENT


 Ensure availability of critical materials and services while maintaining financial discipline.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Monitor procurement efficiency.
* Review vendor performance.
* Establish vendor SLAs and KPIs.
* Drive strategic sourcing and cost optimisation.
* Monitor inventory levels and stock\-outs.
* Ensure critical medical and non\-medical supplies are available.
* Review contract performance.
* Strengthen vendor governance.
* Reduce wastage, leakage and avoidable expenditure.
* FACILITIES \& INFRASTRUCTURE


 Ensure safe, reliable and patient\-friendly hospital infrastructure.
   

  

* Engineering
* Biomedical equipment
* HVAC
* Electrical systems
* Medical gases
* Fire and life safety
* Security
* Housekeeping
* Laundry
* Food services
* Parking
* Waste management
* Pest control
* Preventive maintenance


 The COO should establish facility uptime, preventive maintenance and service\-level dashboards.
   

  

* EMERGENCY \& BUSINESS CONTINUITY


 Ensure hospital preparedness for emergencies and operational disruptions.
   

  

* Emergency preparedness.
* Disaster management.
* Business continuity planning.
* Fire and life safety preparedness.
* Mass casualty preparedness.
* Utility failure preparedness.
* IT downtime preparedness.
* Security incident response.
* Pandemic/infectious disease preparedness where applicable.
* GOVERNANCE \& MANAGEMENT REVIEWS


 Establish a disciplined hospital management cadence.
   

  

**Daily:**
* Occupancy
* Admissions/discharges
* Emergency load
* Bed availability
* OT utilisation
* Critical incidents
* Patient complaints
* Staffing issues
* Operational bottlenecks


**Weekly:**
* Revenue
* Occupancy
* Patient experience
* Complaints
* TAT
* Productivity
* Doctor engagement
* Department performance
* Project progress


**Monthly:**
* P\&L
* EBITDA
* Revenue
* ARPOB
* Occupancy
* ALOS
* OT utilisation
* Diagnostics utilisation
* Patient experience

title: Project Leader (CCA) - Customer CoE
description:
**About Us**
 Bain \& Company is a global management consulting that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. We do this by co\-developing and delivering client pitch decks, consulting products, and deliver on Go\-to\-Market solutions. Within the CoE, we build products and deliver solutions that help clients uncover and capture their full potential across the entire sales value chain and customer journey, spanning problem identification, solution design, implementation, and capability building.

We offer extensive professional development opportunities for those who enjoy analytical problem\-solving and creating client\-oriented solutions. The CoE provides a truly global experience, with the chance to collaborate with experts, Bain case teams, and clients around the world, all within an inclusive, collaborative, and fun\-loving team culture. **What You’ll Do**
* Develop high\-impact sales collateral (proposals, discussion decks, RFP/RFI responses) for priority pursuits across regions, ensuring alignment with Bain’s value proposition and client context

* Use technology, automation tools, and AI platforms to optimize proposal development, content reuse, and client communication workflows

**About You**
* Undergraduate degree (preferably in Engineering, Business, or Economics) with 4\-6 years of experience, or Postgraduate degree (MBA preferred) with 3\-5 years of experience

* Experience within a Professional Services or within customer and marketing strategy division in the Industry
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel is essential. Hands\-on experience with leading GenAI platforms such as Claude and OpenAI is required, not only for proposal development and content refinement but also for creating client\-facing dashboards and interactive solutions. Additional preferred skills include:
* Digital and web content management platforms (e.g., EPiServer), demo and video creation tools (e.g., Synthesia, Adobe Suite)
* Programming, data management, and web application development skills (e.g., Python, HTML, Java, etc.)
* Building AI\-powered apps, prototypes, and POCs using AI agents, natural language prompting, and vibe coding platforms (e.g., Replit and Vercel)
* Strong communication and presentation skills with ability to engage senior stakeholders. Having an experience of leading a team is a strong advantage

**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company

**Why you do not want to miss this career opportunity** 




  




* We are a mission\-driven firm that is revolutionising the Insurance and Banking industry. We are not aiming to incrementally push the current boundaries; we redefine them.

title: Lifestyle Manager
description:
About Pinch
 




  






 The last decade and a half has been dedicated to the rise of convenience in every way. Organisations, one after the other, have created products and services which make the life of customers convenient. Yet the pain, pressure and stress of the modern world has not really reduced, leave aside going away.
 




  






 At Pinch, our dream is to transform the physical environment of a family and help them create space for the truly important things, allowing them to focus on themselves and their mental well\-being to build a meaningful life, filled with purpose and joy. We wish to build a home management system, which not only does the daily chores, seamlessly and effortlessly, but also preempts the needs of our customers, enhances their lifestyle in every
 





 aspect while giving them the peace of mind to focus on achieving more in life. From full housekeeping to a quick tidy up or a dog walk, Pinch is available for the families all the time. We work as an extension of our customers’ family and bring to the table what is best for them.
 




  






 With our monthly plan, we combine services such as housekeeping, maintenance, food \& nutrition management, grocery resupply, laundry management, etc. tailored to the unique needs of each family. On top, a dedicated Lifestyle Manager helps them with any miscellaneous home requests, from decorating home with fresh flowers to arranging a repairman for the broken washing machine, to planning details of the next holiday, taking care of children or the elderly. Basically, anything and everything our customers and their families would need to live a comfortable, convenient, healthy, guilt\-free, and inspired life.
 




  






 How will we do it?
 





 There are three fundamental aspects of our business model which will help deliver this life\-transforming service:
 




  






 Lifestyle Manager: Armed with irrefutable professional attention, prompt service, strict quality controls and effective anticipation of needs, our dedicated lifestyle team helps customers in a variety of things. Be it sending flowers on birthdays, reminders for paying bills on time, and even recommending the latest home products. Our team of lifestyle managers are mapped to each family, do all the research, analysis and short list the best products and service experience for the customers.
 





 Trained Professionals: Offering a much more professional service than domestic helpers, with Pinch, customers are served by a team of home specialists who will handle all the housework, chores and running around. If they already have a helper, we will have them trained by us to maximise their potential and effectiveness.
 





 Technology: We take the hassle out of home management. Customers are given constant home and personal management advice, reminders and nudges, where the back\-end system incorporates an algorithm that remembers preferences and generates instructions to meet our customers’ home goals.
 




  






 Pinch has 4 broad customer segments:
 



* Individuals \& Families
* Landlords \& Second Home Owners
* Developers \& RWAs
* Corporates



  





*The Lifestyle Manager – An Extension of the Customer’s Family* 




  






 A Lifestyle Manager at Pinch is deeply empathetic, has a natural attitude towards helping people and is committed to improving lives for the better. Every family has their own set of needs, wants, preferences \& behaviours. Our Lifestyle Manager understands this, has the ability to develop a deep bond with a family \& its members, and designs solutions keeping their specific requirements in mind. S/he is warm, courteous, patient \& a good listener, with an eye for detail. S/he is able to not just solve for what the customer asks, but even anticipate or pre\-empt their needs, through her/his deep understanding of the family. Our customer’s peace of mind relies immensely on the Lifestyle Manager, and how efficiently and swiftly s/he works with the other teams at Pinch to be able to meet the customer’s requirements. The Lifestyle Manager has a service\-oriented mindset that puts the customer first, even before the company. Practically, s/he is an extension of the customer’s family \& thus, the most important link between the company \& the customer.
 




  





*Responsibilities of a Lifestyle Manager* 




  






 1\. Customer Onboarding
 



* Understand the prevailing context in a customer’s life with respect to the services we intend to provide.
* Explain how Pinch can help ease the customer’s life by delivering these services in a transformative manner.
* Handhold \& onboard the customer seamlessly onto Pinch’s ecosystem of services.



  






 2\. Solution Deployment
 



* Define \& agree upon the interventions needed for fulfilling the customer’s requirements.
* Deploy a set of trained domestic helps at the household to take care of the day\-to\-day chores, \& undertake periodic supervision of their work.
* Assign errands to the Operations Associates and monitor them for completion to the family’s satisfaction.



  






 3\. Partner Management
 



* Work with Pinch’s central partner ecosystem to deploy solutions at the customer’s household and fulfil any new requirements from time to time.
* Onboard and work with a local set of quality partners in the immediate vicinity of the customer’s location to bring about greater efficiency.
* Oversee the quality of work done by the partners and provide valuable feedback to the central Partnership teams on the same.



  






 4\. Customer Lifecycle Management
 



* Have deeper dialogues and conversations with the customer that ease them into the Pinch journey across the 5 stages of pain, convenience, pleasure, delight \& transformation.
* Educate and enable customers to adopt a wider range of Pinch’s services.



  






 5\. Customer Feedback \& Service Improvement
 



* Determine customer satisfaction with regard to the various services provided by Pinch.
* Identify \& work on areas of improvement. Iterate the solution design to continually keep enhancing customer service.
* Raise \& highlight any complaints, queries, grievances, feedback etc. to the relevant teams for resolution.



  






 Who are we looking for?
 



* Candidate with Hospitality background
* Candidate with communication and public relation skills
* Candidate with Event management, language and intercultural communication background
* Passionate about the cause the company is working towards
* Excited about wanting to work in a start\-up
* Self\-motivated \& loves taking initiative
* Growth mindset, focussed on improving business outcomes
* Able to hustle, loves being out on the ground, \& is willing to get his/her hands dirty
* Embraces ambiguity \& uncertainty
* Focused on problem\-solving, has a solution\-oriented mindset
* Hard\-working, is able to work for long hours
* Excellent team player
* Ability to multitask on multiple projects at the same time
* Ability to handle pressure and failure



  






 Qualifications:
 



* Bachelor's degree preferably in hospitality.

 The Manager – Colleague Benefits Operations is responsible for leading and managing the end\-to\-end administration of colleague insurance, health, and retirement benefit programs in an
 **APAC centric operating environment** 
 . The role requires
 **expertise in people leadership** 
 , operational governance, and compliance with Indian and other APAC markets statutory and regulatory frameworks, while ensuring a consistent, accurate, and colleague\-centric benefits experience.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities – APAC Benefits Operations \& Delivery** 
**Benefits Operations \& APAC Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end benefits operations and service delivery across APAC markets, ensuring consistent, accurate, and colleague\-centric execution across diverse regulatory and benefits environments.
* Oversee administration of market\-specific benefits, including medical and life insurance, personal accident coverage, Social Security, retirement plans, flexible benefits, company car programs, loans, and other local benefits.
* Ensure accurate and timely processing of enrollments, exits, dependent changes, claims coordination, life events, contributions, and benefit elections across APAC.
* Establish regional service standards and ensure delivery against defined SLAs, quality, accuracy, and colleague experience metrics.
* Partner with Payroll and Finance teams across APAC to ensure accurate deductions, contributions, reconciliations, funding, and statutory submissions.
* Balance regional standardization with market\-specific requirements, ensuring global and regional policies are operationalized appropriately within each country.


**Expert People Leadership**
* Provide strong regional leadership to benefits operations professionals supporting multiple APAC markets, establishing clear accountability, performance expectations, and service standards.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members to build deep benefits expertise, multi\-market capability, leadership depth, and succession readiness.
* Build an operating model that supports effective collaboration across countries, time zones, functions, and regional/global teams.
* Lead teams through organizational change, process transformation, automation, technology implementation, vendor transitions, and policy changes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, risk awareness, inclusion, and colleague empathy.


**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a senior operational owner for relationships with regional and in\-country insurers, brokers, TPAs, Social Security and retirement plan administrators, trustees, fund managers, and other benefits service providers.
* Establish consistent vendor governance and performance management frameworks across APAC, including SLA monitoring, service reviews, issue management, and escalation protocols.
* Partner closely with HR, Total Rewards, Payroll, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, Risk, and HR Business Partners at market, regional, and global levels.
* Support annual renewals, benefit plan reviews, vendor selections, contract negotiations, market transitions, and implementation of new or enhanced benefit programs.
* Drive effective resolution of complex vendor and colleague escalations while identifying systemic opportunities for service improvement.


**Process Excellence \& Regional Governance**
* Drive operational excellence across APAC through standardization, simplification, digitization, and automation of benefits processes.
* Develop a scalable regional operating model while appropriately accommodating country\-specific statutory, regulatory, and policy requirements.
* Maintain robust SOPs, process maps, controls, governance standards, and documentation aligned with enterprise audit, compliance, and risk requirements.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual intervention, processing errors, turnaround times, operational costs, and colleague escalations.
* Establish clear ownership and governance for processes spanning multiple markets, vendors, and internal teams.
* Ensure appropriate data governance, confidentiality, privacy, access controls, and information\-security standards across the APAC benefits ecosystem.


**Dashboard Reporting, Analytics \& Metrics**
* Design and own APAC\-wide operational dashboards and management reporting covering service volumes, turnaround times, accuracy, backlog, SLA performance, colleague escalations, vendor performance, and risk indicators.
* Establish consistent KPIs and KRIs across markets while incorporating country\-specific measures where required.
* Analyze regional and market\-level trends to identify service gaps, emerging risks, capacity requirements, control weaknesses, and improvement opportunities.
* Provide actionable insights and regular performance updates to APAC and global senior leadership and governance forums.
* Ensure data integrity and consistent definitions across HR systems, benefits platforms, payroll systems, vendors, and regional reporting.


**Risk Management \& Operational Resilience**
* Lead identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of operational risks across APAC benefits delivery.
* Develop and maintain risk and control frameworks aligned with enterprise standards and applicable market requirements.
* Conduct periodic risk assessments, control reviews, scenario analysis, and operational resilience exercises for critical benefits processes.
* Identify dependencies and concentration risks across vendors, systems, processes, and key operational resources.
* Maintain appropriate business continuity and contingency arrangements for critical benefits services across APAC.
* Ensure critical colleague benefits can continue to be administered effectively during vendor, technology, workforce, or other operational disruptions.


**Operational Risk Events \& Issue Management**
* Own and oversee the end\-to\-end management of benefits\-related operational risk events across APAC, including identification, documentation, impact assessment, escalation, remediation, and closure.
* Lead structured root cause analysis (RCA) and ensure effective preventive and corrective actions are implemented.
* Establish regional visibility of risk events, near misses, control failures, recurring issues, and emerging operational risks.
* Track remediation plans and report material issues through appropriate market, regional, and enterprise governance forums.
* Ensure timely and sustainable closure of audit findings, compliance observations, control deficiencies, and risk actions.
* Use risk\-event insights to strengthen processes, controls, training, technology, and vendor governance across markets.


**Compliance, Risk \& APAC Regulatory Framework**
* Ensure benefits operations comply with applicable employment, benefits, Social Security, retirement, tax, data privacy, and other regulatory requirements across APAC markets.
* Establish a structured mechanism to monitor and operationalize regulatory and statutory changes affecting benefits administration across the region.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Tax, Payroll, Risk, and local HR teams to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into operational processes and controls.
* Ensure timely and accurate statutory filings, Social Security and retirement contributions, reporting, reconciliations, and regulatory submissions, where applicable.
* Support internal audits, statutory audits, regulatory reviews, and compliance assessments across APAC markets.
* Proactively identify and mitigate regulatory, operational, compliance, data, financial, and third\-party risks.
* Maintain appropriate evidence, documentation, and controls to demonstrate ongoing regulatory compliance and audit readiness across the region.


**APAC Delivery Strategy \& Transformation**
* Define and execute the APAC Benefits Operations delivery strategy, aligned with broader Total Rewards, HR, and enterprise priorities.
* Develop a scalable regional delivery model that creates the right balance between centralized operations, market expertise, and vendor\-supported delivery.
* Build a roadmap for process harmonization, automation, digital enablement, self\-service, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with global and regional stakeholders on benefits technology implementations, platform migrations, vendor consolidations, and operating\-model transformations.
* Establish mechanisms to share best practices and lessons learned across APAC markets, reducing unnecessary process variation.
* Continuously assess the maturity of APAC benefits operations and develop initiatives that strengthen service quality, colleague experience, controls, resilience, and scalability.


**Qualifications**
**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Expert people leadership and team management capabilities
* Deep knowledge of APAC colleague benefits and statutory frameworks
* Strong operational, analytical, and problem\-solving skills
* Proven experience managing vendors and third\-party administrators
* Ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders
* High attention to detail with a strong control mindset
* Colleague\-centric service orientation

title: Plant Head (Washing Machine Manufacturing)
description:
Job Description \- Plant Head (Washing Machine Manufacturing)
 



  





 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 



 Reports to: Managing Director
 



 Team size: \~200 (direct \+ indirect)
 



 CTC: ₹12 LPA
 



 Department: Manufacturing / Operations
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 Own end\-to\-end plant operations for washing machine manufacturing \- injection moulding, sub\-assembly, and final assembly lines. The role carries full accountability for production planning, output, quality, manpower, cost control and plant discipline. The right person is a hands\-on moulding expert who can also run a shop floor of 200 people and defend a costing sheet in front of management.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \#Moulding
 



 \- Full technical ownership of the injection moulding shop — machine setting, process parameters, cycle time optimisation, material drying, shot weight and rejection control.
 



 \- Mould maintenance and repair: preventive maintenance schedules, trial runs, troubleshooting short shots, flash, warpage, sink marks, weld lines, and colour/streak issues.
 



 \- Coordinate with tool room and mould suppliers on new mould development, T0/T1 trials and corrections.
 



 \- Control regrind usage, scrap generation and material yield.
 



  





 \#Assembly \& Production
 



 \- Plan and execute daily, weekly and monthly production schedules for washing machine models against the sales/dispatch plan.
 



 \- Line balancing, manpower deployment, cycle time and takt time management across assembly lines.
 



 \- Drive OEE, first\-pass yield and on\-time dispatch; escalate and resolve line stoppages.
 



 \- Coordinate with stores, purchase and quality to prevent line\-down situations.
 



  





 \#Materials
 



 \- Working knowledge of plastics (PP, ABS, HIPS, PC blends), masterbatch, sheet metal, motors, gearboxes, wiring harness, PCBA and packaging materials.
 



 \- Material planning, BOM validation, inventory norms, WIP control and shortage management.
 



 \- Support vendor development and material cost reduction initiatives.
 



  





 \#Costing \& Reporting (Excel)
 



 \- Build and maintain product costing sheets — material cost, conversion cost, moulding cost per part, labour, overheads and scrap cost.
 



 \- Strong command of Excel: pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, conditional formatting, dashboards and MIS reports for management review.
 



 \- Track cost per unit, rejection cost, power/utility consumption and productivity metrics month\-on\-month.
 



  





 \#Leadership \& People
 



 \- Lead a plant team of approximately 200 including supervisors, operators, technicians, quality and stores staff.
 



 \- Shift planning, attendance, discipline, training, skill matrix and contract labour management.
 



 \- Drive 5S, Kaizen, safety and statutory compliance on the shop floor.
 



 \- Build a performance culture with clear daily targets and review discipline.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 \#Candidate Requirements
 



  





 \- Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Plastics, Production or Electrical Engineering. Plastics/Tool engineering (CIPET) strongly preferred.
 



 \- 12–18 years in manufacturing, with at least 4–5 years as Plant Head / Works Manager / Production Head.
 



 \- Mandatory: hardcore injection moulding background with hands\-on mould repair capability — not supervisory\-only exposure.
 



 \- Experience in white goods, home appliances or high\-volume plastics assembly. Washing machine experience is a strong plus.
 



 \- Proven record of managing 150\+ workforce.
 



 \- Advanced Excel. ERP exposure (SAP/Tally/other) preferred.
 



 \- Knowledge of ISO 9001 systems, BIS requirements and basic labour compliance.
 



 \- Strong leadership, ownership, problem\-solving and communication in Hindi and English.
 



**\*Must have experienced in washing machine, air cooler \& big plastic appliances plant/factory.** 




  





 \#Key Performance Indicators
 



  





 \| Area \| Metric \|
 



 \|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|
 



 \| Production \| Plan vs actual adherence, daily output \|
 



 \| Quality \| Moulding rejection %, assembly FPY, customer complaints \|
 



 \| Cost \| Cost per unit, scrap %, material yield \|
 



 \| Machine \| OEE, moulding downtime, mould breakdown hours \|
 



 \| People \| Absenteeism, attrition, productivity per head \|
 



 \| Safety \| Zero lost\-time incidents, 5S score \|

description:
**Location: Gurgaon (on\-site)** 




**Experience: 2\-6 years** 




  





 Oyela is a fast\-growing fashion D2C brand redefining the Indian fashion ecosystem by combining technology and design. In just a few months we've scaled to a multi\-million ARR by delivering trend\-driven, high\-quality apparel to a new generation of fashion\-forward consumers.
 



  





**Role\- Category Manager** 




  





 Own a category end to end \- what we make, how much of it we make, what it costs, what it sells for and what it earns. You will build the range, drive the buying calendar with design and sourcing, and carry the number for revenue, margin and inventory health. This is a P\&L ownership role with targets attached, not a coordination role.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 



* Category P\&L: Revenue, gross margin and contribution margin after returns, discounts and marketing spend.
* Range \& assortment planning: Build the seasonal range architecture \- sub\-categories, price bands, colour and size depth, core vs trend vs hero styles.
* Buying \& OTB: Own open\-to\-buy, first buy quantities and reorder calls. Balance newness against sell\-through and hold the discipline of buying to plan.
* Vendor \& costing: Work with sourcing team to finalise costing approval, MOQ, lead times
* Pricing \& markdown: Set MRP and selling price ladders, build the discount and markdown calendar, and protect margin through sale events.
* Liquidation plan \- Own the ageing and liquidation plan for slow movers.
* Inventory health: Own sell\-through, weeks of cover, stock turns, ageing buckets and out\-of\-stock on best sellers. No stock outs on winners, no dead stock at season end.
* Weekly trading: Run the style\-level business review \- what to push, repeat, reprice or kill. Work with marketing on hero style selection, with catalog on listing quality (titles, images, attributes, size charts) and with the site team on collections, sort order and merchandising.
* Returns \& quality loop: Track return reasons by style \- fit, quality, description mismatch \- and close the loop with design, sourcing and quality before the next buy.
* Trend \& competition: Track competitor assortments, price points and launch cadence, and predict range plan 150 days beforehand.
* Own website sales runs and curation, integrate influencer content to website



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* 2–6 yrs in fashion / D2C / ecommerce
* Strong trend sense \+ commercial thinking
* Comfortable with data (conversion, AOV, sell\-through)
* High ownership, fast execution mindset
* Working knowledge of Shopify and/or marketplace back\-ends (Myntra, Ajio, Amazon, Flipkart) for catalog, pricing and inventory.
* Sharp commercial judgement and the willingness to kill a style you personally liked because the data says so.



  





**What we offer:** 




 Full ownership of a category with direct founder access, the autonomy to build the range, pricing and vendor strategy from the ground up, a collaborative and growth\-focused culture, and competitive compensation with performance\-based growth.

description:
**Job Title : Assistant Manager** 




**Function : Governance, Risk and Compliance Services (GRCS)** 




**Location : Gurgaon** 




  





**OVERVIEW** 




 KPMG is a global network of professional firms providing Audit, Tax and Advisory services. We operate in 156 countries and have 152,000 people working in member firms around the world.
 



 KPMG in India, a professional services firm, is the Indian member firm of KPMG International and was established in September 1993\. Our professionals leverage the global network of firms, providing detailed knowledge of local laws, regulations, markets and competition. KPMG in India provide services to over 4,500 international and national clients, in India. KPMG has offices across India in Delhi, Chandigarh, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Pune, Chennai, Bangalore, Kochi, Hyderabad and Kolkata. The Indian firm has access to more than 7,000 Indian and expatriate professionals, many of whom are internationally trained. We strive to provide rapid, performance\-based, industry\-focused and technology\-enabled services, which reflect a shared knowledge of global and local industries and our experience of the Indian business environment.
 



 KPMG Advisory professionals provide advice and assistance to enable companies, intermediaries and public sector bodies to mitigate risk, improve performance, and create value. KPMG firms provide a wide range of Risk Consulting, Management Consulting and Transactions \& Restructuring services that can help clients respond to immediate needs as well as put in place the strategies for the longer term.
 



 With increasing regulatory requirements, the need for greater transparency in operations, and disclosure norms, stakeholders require assurance beyond the traditional critique of numbers. Hence assurance is being increasingly required on industry issues, business risks and key business processes. The Governance, Risk \& Compliance Services practice assists companies and public sector bodies to mitigate risk, improve performance and create value.
 



  





 We assist our clients to effectively manage business and process risks by providing a full spectrum of corporate governance, risk management, and Compliance Services. These services are tailored to meet client’s individual needs, and provide effective support to management in meeting the challenges and opportunities presented by today's complex business environment.
 



  





 Our professionals provide the experience to help companies stay on track and deal with risks that could unhinge their business survival. Our services enable clients to effectively co\-ordinate their key growth, quality and operational challenges and working in partnership with us, clients have the benefits of KPMG's experienced, objective, and industry\-grounded viewpoints.
 



  





  





**Following are some of our key service offerings:** 



* Risk Based Internal Audit
* Enterprise Risk Management
* Risk Assessment
* Model Business Process Development
* Sarbanes – Oxley 404 Assistance
* Compliance Assistance – Contracts and regulations
* Corporate Governance Advisory– Review and Assessment
* Revenue Assurance
* Control Self Assessment
* Continuous Auditing / Continuous Monitoring
* Apart from the above service offerings, we also assist client organizations around various aspects viz. Accounting Manuals, Capital Projects Audits, Project focused Control Assessment, setting up IA function, etc.



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Assistant Managers are project leaders/project team members who will be involved in conducting process consulting/ internal audit/ risk consulting and execution of other solutions of GRCS
* Assistant Managers may pay the role of team leader on engagements with 1\-3 team members reporting to them for the project. AMs have responsibility of reviewing the work done (Deliverables) by the team members
* Interact with the client representatives for the ongoing requirements of the project
* Proactively does sales oriented reporting during projects. These would include identifying possible business opportunities for various practices within KPMG
* Consistently deliver quality client services and take charge of the project area assigned to him/her
* Monitor progress, manage risk and verify key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes
* Demonstrate in\-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Demonstrate ability to assimilate to new knowledge
* Possess good business acumen. Remain current on new developments in advisory services capabilities and industry knowledge
* The job would require travel to client locations within India and abroad



  





**THE INDIVIDUAL** 



* Have experience in process consulting/ internal audit/ risk consulting
* Possess strong domain knowledge, understanding of business processes and possible risks in operations of at least one industry sector
* Ability to perform and interpret process gap analysis
* Ability to identify risks in business processes
* Understanding of control rationalization, optimization, effectiveness and efficiency
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Possess strong data analytics skills and knowledge of advanced data analytical tools will be an advantage
* Strong written and verbal communication skills (presentation skills)
* Consistent display of leadership skills
* Ability to work well in teams
* Understanding of IT systems, Knowledge of MS office ( MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word etc)
* Have the ability to work under pressure – stringent deadlines and tough client conditions which may demand extended working hours
* Willingness to travel within India or abroad for continuous long periods of time
* Demonstrate integrity, values, principles, and work ethic and lead by example



  





**Qualification** 



* Qualified CAs with articleship from Big\-4 firms, MBAs from top 10 Business Schools with 3\-5 years of experience in risk consulting/ operations or compliance function role in the industry (Understanding of internal audit, business processes, sector understanding).
* Qualified CAs (non Big4 firms) / MBAs (non top 10 B\-Schools) with 3 – 6 years OR Graduates (BE/B.Tech, BCom, BBM) with 6 \- 8 years of relevant experience as above
* Graduates with CS/ ICWA with 5 – 7 years of relevant experience as above
* Certifications like Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) would be an added advantage.



  





**SELECTION PROCESS** 



* Candidates should expect 2 \- 3 rounds of personal or telephonic interviews to assess fitment and communication skills



  





**Compensation**

* Details of the compensation breakup will be shared with short\-listed candidates only



  





**People BENEFITS** 



* Continuous learning program
* Driving a culture of recognition through ‘ENCORE’ our quarterly rewards and recognition program

* Expansive general and accidental coverage for staff
* Executive Health checkup (Manager \& above, and for staff above the age of 30\)
* Les Concierge desk

* Various other people friendly initiatives
* Strong commitment to our Values such as CSR initiatives
