title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Supply Chain Manager
 



  





 About Lyor
 



 Lyor provides fully furnished, professionally managed rental homes and furniture rentals. We manufacture much of our furniture in\-house and manage the installation, maintenance and movement of assets across multiple apartments. As we scale, we're hiring a hands\-on Manager \- Supply Chain \& Asset Control to own this end to end.
 



  





 The role
 



 You'll run the supply chain for Lyor Homes and furniture rentals: purchasing, stock control, asset movements and apartment asset registers. Our Odoo setup is still evolving, so you'll identify gaps and help define the right workflow \- not only operate an established ERP.
 



  





 Day in the life
 



 This is a hands\-on role. On a typical office day, you will:
 



 \- Start with the supply plan: review upcoming apartment installations, furniture rental deliveries and maintenance replacements. Check what is available, what is reserved, what the factory will deliver and what must be purchased.
 



 \- Set priorities for the team: assign purchase follow\-ups, receiving, dispatches and stock checks. Resolve shortages before they delay an installation.
 



 \- Coordinate across teams: speak with design on specifications and substitutions, the factory on deliveries, and the projects team on site readiness and installation dates.
 



 \- Control purchases and movements: review purchase orders and delivery commitments. Check that items received, transferred or dispatched are recorded against the correct location in Odoo.
 



 \- Investigate discrepancies: compare apartment asset sheets with dispatch and installation records. Follow up on missing, damaged or wrongly allocated items until records and physical position match.
 



 \- Close the day with clear information: confirm the next day's deliveries and dispatches, update unresolved issues with owners and dates, and report any risk to an apartment handover.
 



  





 You'll also spend time at the factory, store and apartments verifying records against physical assets \- managing today's work while improving the process, so purchases, stock levels and apartment assets no longer depend on people's memory. The daily output is simple: the team knows what is needed next, where each asset is, what is delayed, and who is resolving every discrepancy.
 



  





 What we're looking for
 



 \- Hands\-on experience across procurement, inventory control and movement of physical assets across multiple locations
 



 \- You've built or improved a process in a growing business \- experience only within a mature, fully configured ERP won't be sufficient
 



 \- Strong Excel skills and working ERP experience; Odoo preferred
 



 \- You can reconcile system records with physical items, trace discrepancies and follow them through to closure
 



 \- Strong planning, vendor follow\-up and communication skills, with willingness to visit sites and verify work personally
 



 \- Furniture rental, serviced apartments, hospitality, retail fit\-outs, appliances or equipment rental backgrounds are all relevant
 



 \- Supply chain degree welcome, not mandatory
 



  





 What success looks like
 



 Every new apartment has an accurate, verified asset register at handover. Stock availability and reservations are visible to the team. Purchases and dispatches are planned ahead \- and every asset movement can be traced without relying on one person's memory.
 



  





 Details
 



 Delhi NCR (regular visits to our Okhla factory, stores and apartments)
 



 Reporting to: Founder / COO
 



 Experience: \~6\-10 years \| On\-site

title: Lead, Strategic Partnerships and Program Implementation
description:
**Position Overview:** 




  





 Room to Read India is seeking an experienced professional to lead program implementation across multiple locations and drive high\-quality proposal and concept note development for the Country Office. The role will work closely with the Program Operations Director, State and cross\-functional teams to ensure effective execution, track progress, address implementation challenges, and capture program learning. The role will also develop evidence\-based, donor\-responsive proposals and concept notes in collaboration with Programs, RM\&E, Finance, Fundraising and Global Grant Management teams. Strong project management, analytical, writing, synthesis and stakeholder management skills are essential.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  





**Proposal Development for Strategic Partnerships (50%).** 




  




* Lead the development and writing of high\-quality proposals for Room to Read India.
* Translate program strategies, implementation experience, evidence and organizational priorities into clear, compelling and donor\-responsive narratives.
* Work closely with Programs, RM\&E, Finance, Dev, Global Grant Management and other teams to gather, synthesize and validate technical inputs for proposals.
* Develop proposal narratives, theories of change, program approaches, implementation plans, results frameworks and other relevant sections as required.
* Coordinate inputs from multiple stakeholders and ensure consistency, coherence and quality across technical and financial components of proposals.
* Develop proposal content that clearly articulates the problem, proposed intervention, implementation approach, expected results, evidence and Room to Read’s comparative strengths.
* Ensure that proposals are responsive to donor requirements, guidelines, evaluation criteria and submission timelines.
* Review and strengthen proposal drafts to improve clarity, structure, logic, persuasiveness and alignment between program design, outcomes, activities, budgets and M\&E frameworks.
* Maintain and continuously strengthen a repository of proposal content, program evidence, organizational information, impact stories, case studies and other reusable resources.
* Develop standard content and templates that can enable faster, sharper and more consistent proposal development.
* Coordinate proposal review processes and ensure timely incorporation of feedback from internal and global stakeholders.



  





**Program Learning, Evidence \& Documentation (10%)** 




  




* Capture and synthesize implementation insights, innovations, challenges, success stories and lessons from State teams and program locations.
* Work with RM\&E and Program teams to identify relevant evidence and data that can strengthen program planning, communication and proposal development.
* Translate implementation experience and evidence into compelling narratives, case studies, briefs and proposal content.
* Maintain an updated evidence and learning bank to support proposal development and strategic program discussions.
* Identify recurring implementation issues and opportunities for cross\-state learning and improvement.



  





**Program Implementation \& Delivery (40%)** 




  




* Accountable for ensuring all projects in select geography achieve their respective goals.
* Lead and coordinate implementation of multiple projects/program initiatives across states and locations, ensuring alignment with approved plans, objectives, timelines and program KPIs.
* Work closely with State and Country Office teams to translate program strategies and plans into clear implementation priorities and actions.
* Track key implementation milestones, deliverables, dependencies and risks across projects and proactively flag areas requiring management attention.
* Facilitate periodic implementation reviews with State teams and relevant Country Office functions to assess progress, identify bottlenecks and agree on corrective actions.
* Ensure that required program permissions, approvals and implementation processes are in place in coordination with relevant teams.
* Monitor implementation against agreed timelines, quality parameters and budgets and support teams in addressing deviations.
* Ensure timely completion and submission of program reports and other key implementation deliverables.
* Support effective utilization of program budgets and track significant variances, risks and implementation implications.
* Work with relevant teams to ensure that implementation learning and emerging challenges are documented and translated into actionable improvements.



  





**Qualifications:** 




  





**Required:** 




  




* Master’s degree preferred in Education, Development Studies, Public Policy, Management, Communications or a related field.
* 7–12 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in program implementation, program management, proposal development, fundraising, consulting, development sector or related fields.
* Demonstrated experience of managing or coordinating large\-scale programs/projects involving multiple locations and stakeholders.
* Strong demonstrated experience in proposal writing and concept note development, including the ability to independently develop high\-quality narrative content.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong ability to synthesize complex information into clear, structured and compelling documents.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams and coordinating multiple inputs to deliver time\-bound outputs.
* Strong analytical, project management and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working with budgets, implementation plans, project trackers and performance reports.
* Strong proficiency in preparing presentations, briefing notes, reports and other professional communication materials.
* Experience in the development/social impact/education sector would be an advantage.



  





**Competencies \& Attributes** 



* Strong execution orientation: Demonstrates ownership for moving plans from strategy to implementation and ensuring timely delivery.
* Excellent writing and communication: Able to develop clear, compelling and well\-structured proposals, concept notes and program documents.
* Structured thinker: Able to break down complex problems, connect information across functions and develop practical solutions.
* Strong project management: Able to manage multiple priorities, timelines, stakeholders and deliverables simultaneously.
* Collaborative and influencing: Comfortable working across functions and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
* Analytical and detail\-oriented: Able to work with qualitative and quantitative information and identify key insights, gaps and risks.
* Proactive problem solver: Anticipates implementation challenges and takes initiative to address them.
* Adaptable and resilient: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with changing priorities and tight deadlines.
* High ownership and accountability: Demonstrates discipline, follow\-through and commitment to quality.
* Passion for equity and education: Strong alignment with Room to Read’s mission of improving learning outcomes and advancing gender equality.



  





**Compensation:** 




  





 Room to Read offers a competitive salary with excellent benefits. Benefits include thirteenth month bonus, health insurance, and a retirement plan. The non\-monetary compensation includes a unique opportunity to be part of an innovative, meaningful, and rapidly growing organization that is transforming the lives of millions of children in developing countries through literacy and gender equality in education.
 



  





**Room to Read is a child\-safe organization; all personnel are expected to adhere to Room to Read’s Child Protection Policy and Child Protection Code of Conduct.**

title: Associate Director- TraumaCare
description:
Last date of application: 15 Oct 2026
   

  

 Location: New Delhi
   

  

 Key Partners: Government of India,Skoll Foundation, Mulago Foundation, Cartier, Philanthropy, Škoda Auto Volkswagen India, Hindustan Unilever, BCG India, etc
   

  

 Are you passionate about saving lives and creating lasting impact in healthcare? Are you a clinically trained professional who is excited by the opportunity to shape and scale high impact trauma care and health systems initiatives across India? If so, we invite you to join SaveLIFE Foundation and help transform the Right to Trauma Care into a measurable, accessible, and sustainable reality for every person in India.
   

  

**About SaveLIFE Foundation**
 SaveLIFE Foundation (SLF) is an award\-winning, independent non\-profit organization committed to saving lives on roads across India and the Global South. By combining grassroots action with systems reform, SLF has been at the forefront of introducing landmark road safety innovations—such as India’s Good Samaritan Law and the Zero\-Fatality Corridor (ZFC) model. Our work has helped reduce road crash deaths by up to 67% on some of India’s most dangerous highways and has been recognized by institutions such as the Skoll Foundation, World Bank, and Government of India.
   

  

 At SLF, we believe that road crashes are not accidents—they are preventable tragedies. We are on a mission to prove that loss of life on roads is not a price we must pay for mobility.
   

  

 Join us to help scale this mission.
   

  

**About The Role**
 SaveLIFE Foundation is seeking an experienced and mission\-driven leader to spearhead the organisation’s Trauma Care \& Health Systems portfolio, with a particular focus on translating the Supreme Court of India’s landmark 2026 recognition of the Right to Trauma Care as an integral part of the Right to
   

  

 Life under Article 21 into a measurable and scalable system across India.
   

  

 Role and Responsibilities
   

  

**I. Right To Trauma Care – National Implementation**
* Translate the Supreme Court’s directions into a coherent national trauma\-care implementation strategy for SLF;
* Develop State, district and highway\-level implementation roadmaps;
* Identify gaps in trauma\-care systems and prioritise high\-impact interventions;
* Support governments in developing time\-bound implementation plans and mechanisms for monitoring compliance;


**II. Trauma\-Care Network Development**
* Establish (and lead) guidelines for assessments of existing trauma\-care infrastructure, hospitals and referral networks;
* Develop models for trauma\-centre designation, grading and referral;
* Adapt and disseminate guidelines among various relevant stakeholders for facility upgradation based on levels of care;


**III. Ambulance \& Pre\-Hospital Emergency Care**
* Develop a framework and guidelines for assessment and repositioning of ambulance networks
* on National and State Highways (using crash, population, geography and travel\-time data available);
* Establish and monitor response\-time and performance benchmarks;
* Support integration of ambulance systems with 112, GPS/VLTD and relevant emergency\-response platforms;


**IV. Trauma Training \& Capacity Building**
* Develop a national trauma\-care capacity\-building strategy on BLS, ATLS and other recognised trauma\-care training programmes, as appropriate;
* Adapt or develop training and competency frameworks for prehospital and hospital trauma care;
* Establish systems for certification, refresher training, quality assurance and impact
* Measurement;


**V. Government \& Strategic Partnerships**
* Build, manage and represent at Ministry of Health \& Family Welfare; Ministry of Road Transport \& Highways; Government and private hospitals; Medical colleges and trauma centres; Emergency medicine


 and trauma\-care professional bodies; NGOs and civil society organisations; and other agencies
   

  

 Professional Experience
   

  

* 10–15\+ years of progressive professional experience, including direct clinical experience in an Emergency Room (ER), Intensive Care Unit (ICU), or dedicated Trauma Department.
* Demonstrated experience in designing and delivering medical or clinical training is essential.
* Experience in the public health, healthcare, or development sector is highly desirable.
* Postgraduate qualification in one or more of the following areas:


 Public Health, Emergency Medicine, Trauma Care, Healthcare/Hospital Management, Public Policy, Development Studies, Health Systems, or a related discipline.
   

  

* An MBBS/medical qualification, MPH, MHA, MBA Healthcare or equivalent is desirable.


 What You’ll Gain
   

  

* A unique platform to lead change at scale, with the ability to directly influence infrastructure and policy in India and beyond.
* The chance to work with India’s only organization that combines system reform with on\-ground action for road safety.
* Cross\-sector exposure across engineering, governance, public health, and civic engagement.
* An entrepreneurial environment that values innovation, courage, and execution excellence.
* An opportunity to be part of a globally recognized movement saving thousands of lives each year.


 SaveLIFE Foundation is for you if you
   

  

* Crave purpose in your work and want to solve real problems for real people.
* Thrive in a high\-performance environment where outcomes matter.
* Are passionate about improving systems through technology and design.
* Want your work to matter—not just for your company, but for your country.


 Personal Characteristics and Desirable Skills
   

  

* Familiarity with social impact frameworks like Theory of Change or Logic Models.
* Experience working with NGOs, development organizations, or social enterprises.
* Ability to work in a collaborative team environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Passion for social change and a deep interest in contributing to impactful programs that improve lives.

title: General Manager – Design & Architecture
description:
General Manager – Design \& Architecture
 



**Reports to:** 
 Group Head – Projects \& Infrastructure
 



**Function:** 
 Projects \& Infrastructure
 



**Location** 
 \- Delhi / Mumbai / Bangalore
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an accomplished
 **General Manager – Design \& Architecture** 
 to lead the architectural design strategy and design governance for K–12 school campuses across multiple geographies. This is a senior, client\-side leadership role responsible for establishing design standards, driving design excellence, and ensuring that new\-build, expansion, and redevelopment projects translate the Group’s educational vision into high\-quality, future\-ready, scalable, and operationally efficient campuses.
 



  





 The role will work closely with senior leadership, academic and operations teams, project teams, architects, consultants, and external partners, providing strategic design direction from early feasibility and master planning through design development, construction, and handover.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Design Strategy \& Leadership** 



* Lead the overall architectural design strategy for the Group’s school development portfolio across geographies.
* Provide design leadership across campus master planning, new\-build developments, expansions, refurbishments, and brownfield projects.
* Translate educational philosophy, curriculum requirements, student experience, and operational needs into effective architectural solutions.
* Drive pedagogy\-led, child\-centric and future\-ready learning environments aligned with international education standards.
* Establish a consistent design language while allowing appropriate flexibility for local context, regulations, climate, and market requirements.



**Design Governance \& Standards** 



* Develop, implement, and continuously enhance Group\-wide design guidelines, specifications, and campus planning standards.
* Lead key design reviews and approvals across concept, schematic design, design development, tender, and design\-freeze stages.
* Ensure projects meet agreed standards for functionality, quality, safety, accessibility, sustainability, and operational efficiency.
* Identify critical design and coordination risks early and drive timely resolution.
* Benchmark campuses against leading international schools and global best practices.



**Portfolio \& Project Oversight** 



* Provide senior\-level design oversight across multiple projects at different stages of development.
* Review master plans, architectural drawings, layouts, specifications, material selections, and key design packages.
* Ensure alignment between approved design intent and on\-site execution.
* Participate in project reviews covering design progress, timelines, cost implications, risks, and key decisions.
* Support complex brownfield and live\-campus projects while ensuring student safety, operational continuity, and minimal disruption.



**Consultant \& Stakeholder Leadership** 



* Lead and manage relationships with architectural firms, design consultants, specialist consultants, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Support the selection, appointment, briefing, and performance management of external design consultants.
* Work closely with academic leadership, school operations, finance, procurement, IT, safety, and project teams to ensure integrated design solutions.
* Present design concepts, recommendations, options, risks, and investment implications to senior leadership.
* Drive timely decision\-making and accountability across internal and external stakeholders.



**Commercial \& Value Optimization** 



* Ensure design decisions balance quality, functionality, cost, constructability, and lifecycle performance.
* Lead value engineering initiatives without compromising critical educational or design outcomes.
* Challenge consultant proposals and identify opportunities for design simplification, standardisation, and cost optimisation.
* Support development of project budgets through design\-related inputs and evaluation of alternative solutions.
* Promote standardisation and repeatable design solutions where these can improve speed, quality, and cost efficiency across the portfolio.



**Sustainability \& Future\-Ready Campuses** 



* Drive environmentally responsible and resource\-efficient design strategies.
* Promote lifecycle\-focused decision\-making covering energy efficiency, materials, maintenance, durability, and operating costs.
* Incorporate evolving requirements around technology\-enabled learning, flexible learning spaces, wellbeing, accessibility, security, and sustainability.
* Evaluate relevant global design innovations and determine their applicability across the Group’s campuses.



**Team \& Functional Leadership** 



* Build and lead a high\-performing design and architecture function.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to internal architects, designers, and project team members.
* Establish effective design governance processes, review mechanisms, documentation standards, and approval frameworks.
* Strengthen internal design capabilities and reduce dependency on external consultants for strategic design decisions.



  





**Candidate Profile** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in
 **Architecture** 
 from a recognised institution; professional architectural registration preferred.
* Typically
 **15–20\+ years of progressive experience** 
 in architecture, design management, and project delivery, with significant experience in senior leadership roles.
* Strong track record in
 **large\-scale institutional, education, campus, mixed\-use, or complex multi\-building developments** 
 .
* K–12 school or education\-sector design experience would be highly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading multiple projects and managing architectural and multidisciplinary consultants.
* Strong understanding of master planning, architectural design, design development, construction documentation, materials, and site execution.
* Experience working across multiple geographies and familiarity with international design standards and regulatory environments preferred.
* Strong commercial orientation with experience in value engineering, design optimisation, and lifecycle\-cost considerations.
* Ability to engage effectively with senior leadership and translate strategic requirements into practical design solutions.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and decision\-making capabilities.



  





 Why Join
 



 This is an opportunity to take a
 **Group\-level leadership role** 
 in shaping the physical learning environments of an international education organisation.
 



  





 The role offers the opportunity to:
 


* Lead architectural design strategy across a portfolio of international K–12 campuses.
* Influence projects from early\-stage planning through execution and handover.
* Establish Group\-wide design standards and best practices.
* Work directly with senior leadership and multidisciplinary teams across geographies.
* Shape scalable, sustainable, and future\-ready learning environments for students across the Group.

title: Head – School Partnerships & Growth
description:
HEAD – SALES
   

  

**Department:** 
 Sales \& Business Development
   

  

**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Pan India
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 CEO / Business Leadership
   

  

**About EdTerra**
 EdTerra Edventures is a leading experiential learning and educational travel company that designs and delivers immersive learning journeys for school students across India and international destinations.
   

  

 We partner with schools to create meaningful experiences that combine travel, learning, culture, adventure and real\-world exposure.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Head – Sales** 
 to lead EdTerra's sales function and drive the next phase of revenue growth.
   

  

 This is a
 **business leadership role** 
 with end\-to\-end ownership of the sales engine—from market strategy and school acquisition to key account growth, sales\-team performance, forecasting and revenue delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be a commercially strong, data\-driven and inspiring sales leader who can build scalable sales systems while personally driving strategic relationships with large schools and institutional partners.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities1\. Revenue \& Business Growth
   

  

* Own the overall sales revenue, growth and commercial performance for the business.
* Develop and execute the annual and quarterly sales strategy in line with organizational objectives.
* Translate business targets into territory, segment, product and team\-level targets.
* Identify new revenue opportunities across geographies, school segments and products.
* Drive both new business acquisition and growth of existing accounts.
* Develop strategies to increase customer lifetime value, repeat business and wallet share.
* School \& Institutional Partnerships
* Build and maintain strong relationships with school management, principals, trustees, coordinators and other key decision\-makers.
* Lead negotiations and closures for strategic/high\-value school accounts.
* Develop long\-term partnerships with schools and educational institutions.
* Create account\-development plans for key schools.
* Drive cross\-selling and up\-selling across EdTerra's domestic, international and experiential learning programmes.
* Act as the senior escalation point for strategic clients.
* Sales Team Leadership
* Lead and mentor the complete sales organization across regions/functions.
* Define team structures, roles, territories, targets and performance expectations.
* Recruit, coach and develop high\-performing sales managers and sales professionals.
* Establish a strong culture of ownership, accountability and performance.
* Conduct structured weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews.
* Identify capability gaps and implement targeted coaching and development plans.
* Build a strong succession pipeline for critical sales positions.
* Sales Process \& Performance Management
* Build a predictable and scalable sales process from lead generation → qualification → meetings → proposals → negotiation → closure → repeat business.
* Establish clear sales KPIs and performance dashboards.
* Monitor conversion ratios at every stage of the funnel.
* Improve sales productivity and reduce sales\-cycle time.
* Ensure disciplined CRM usage and accurate pipeline management.
* Establish mechanisms for identifying and resolving pipeline bottlenecks.
* Forecasting \& Business Intelligence
* Own the monthly and quarterly sales forecast.
* Maintain strong visibility on pipeline value, probability and expected closures.
* Develop accurate revenue projections based on historical performance and current pipeline.
* Use sales data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
* Present actionable sales insights and recommendations to the leadership team.
* Develop territory\-wise and account\-wise performance dashboards.
* Market Expansion
* Identify and evaluate new cities, regions and school segments for expansion.
* Analyse competitor positioning, pricing, offerings and market trends.
* Develop go\-to\-market strategies for new products and markets.
* Identify emerging opportunities within the education and experiential\-learning ecosystem.
* Work with the leadership team to evaluate strategic partnerships and new business channels.
* Key Account Growth \& Retention
* Build a structured Key Account Management framework.
* Develop annual growth plans for strategic schools.
* Drive repeat journeys, renewals and increased engagement with existing schools.
* Monitor account health, satisfaction and revenue potential.
* Ensure high\-value clients receive proactive relationship management.
* Work with Operations and Customer Experience teams to resolve critical client concerns.
* Commercial \& Margin Ownership
* Balance revenue growth with profitability and contribution margins.
* Participate in pricing and commercial strategy.
* Establish appropriate discounting and negotiation frameworks.
* Monitor deal economics and commercial effectiveness.
* Work closely with Finance to improve collection efficiency and reduce outstanding receivables.
* Ensure sales commitments remain commercially and operationally viable.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration


**Work Closely With**
* Marketing – lead generation, campaigns and brand positioning
* Product – product development, pricing and market fit
* Operations – delivery feasibility and execution
* Finance – pricing, margins, collections and commercial controls
* HR – manpower planning, hiring and capability development
* Customer Experience – client satisfaction and retention


 Ensure seamless alignment between
 **what is sold, what is promised and what is delivered** 
 .
   

  

 Success in the First 12 Months
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To**
* Deliver agreed annual revenue and growth targets.
* Build a predictable and healthy sales pipeline.
* Improve sales conversion and sales productivity.
* Strengthen the key\-school account portfolio.
* Increase repeat business and customer retention.
* Build a high\-performing and accountable sales leadership team.
* Improve forecast accuracy.
* Establish standardized sales processes and performance dashboards.
* Identify and successfully penetrate new markets.
* Improve revenue quality and contribution margins.


 Key Performance Indicators
   

  

**Business**
* Revenue Achievement %
* YoY Revenue Growth
* Gross Contribution / Margin
* New Revenue


**Acquisition**
* New Schools Acquired
* New Revenue from New Accounts
* Conversion Rate
* Average Deal Value


**Retention \& Growth**
* Repeat Revenue %
* School Retention
* Key Account Growth
* Revenue per Strategic Account


**Sales Productivity**
* Pipeline Coverage
* Sales Cycle
* Lead\-to\-Meeting Conversion
* Meeting\-to\-Closure Conversion
* Individual \& Team Productivity


**Forecasting**
* Forecast Accuracy
* Pipeline Health
* Closure Predictability


**People**
* Team Target Achievement
* Sales Attrition
* Manager Productivity
* Internal Talent Development


 Candidate ProfileExperience
   

  

* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in B2B / institutional / consultative sales.
* 4\+ years in a senior sales leadership role managing sizeable sales teams.
* Proven experience owning significant revenue targets.
* Experience managing multi\-city or multi\-region sales operations preferred.
* Strong experience in relationship\-led businesses such as education, EdTech, travel, hospitality, SaaS, media or other B2B services will be advantageous.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, Business Management or a related field preferred.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Revenue \& P\&L Orientation
* B2B / Institutional Sales
* Enterprise/Key Account Management
* Negotiation \& Commercial Acumen
* Sales Forecasting
* CRM \& Sales Analytics
* Market Expansion
* Team Building \& Leadership
* Coaching \& Performance Management
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Executive Communication


 Leadership Traits We Value
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Thinks like a business owner, not just a salesperson.
* Is highly accountable for outcomes.
* Can operate strategically while remaining close to the ground.
* Uses data to make decisions.
* Builds strong, long\-term relationships.
* Can challenge existing processes and create better systems.
* Develops people rather than simply managing them.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
* Has the energy and maturity to represent EdTerra with senior school stakeholders.


 Why Join EdTerra?
   

  

 At EdTerra, sales is not simply about selling a product.
   

  

 It is about building long\-term partnerships with schools and helping create experiences that can have a lasting impact on students.
   

  

 As Head – Sales, you will have the opportunity to
 **shape the sales organization, influence business strategy, build a high\-performing team and directly contribute to EdTerra's next phase of growth.**

title: Sr. Manager Ecom Post Order Operations EM (Location: Gurgaon or Dubai)
description:
**This role can be based in both Gurgaon (India) and Dubai (UAE) offices.**
**Purpose \& Overall Relevance for the Organization**
 eCommerce Post\-Order Operations sits at the core of our online business operations. With thousands of orders fulfilled and returned across Emerging Markets, delivering a seamless, reliable, and efficient experience is critical to meeting growing consumer expectations and creating moments that matter.
   

  

 The Senior Manager Post\-Order Operations will lead the Post\-Order Operations team across Emerging Markets, ensuring that operational execution across outbound and inbound journeys maintains the highest standards of reliability and efficiency. This role drives operational excellence across order fulfillment, delivery, tracking, exceptions, returns, and reverse logistics, while continuously identifying opportunities to elevate consumer experience and operational efficiency.
   

  

 A key responsibility is identifying, evaluating, and enabling new fulfillment capabilities based on consumer needs, business requirements, and market innovations. You will collaborate closely with diverse internal and external stakeholders, uniting technical system knowledge, consumer insights, process thinking, and structured communication.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Post\-Order Operational Excellence
* Own end\-to\-end Post\-Order Operations across Emerging Markets, encompassing order fulfillment, delivery, tracking, delivery exceptions, cancellations, returns, reverse logistics, and refund process governance.
* Ensure reliable and efficient execution of outbound and inbound workflows by establishing clear operational standards, SLAs, governance mechanisms, and performance routines.
* Continuously monitor operational performance, proactively identifying risks, issues, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Drive enhancement across key operational metrics, including OTIF Delivery, delivery reliability, Rev\-to\-net, cancellations, delivery exceptions, returns, and refund turnaround times.
* Ensure effective operational readiness and execution during peak trading periods, major commercial campaigns, and high\-volume events.
* Identify root causes of operational challenges and implement sustainable corrective solutions in partnership with key stakeholders.
* Partner with the eCommerce Planning and SCM teams to align warehouse and carrier processing capacity during both business\-as\-usual (BAU) and peak periods.
* Drive New Delivery \& Fulfillment Capabilities
* Identify and enable new delivery and fulfillment capabilities across Emerging Markets aligned with consumer expectations, business goals, market trends, and industry innovations (including business case definition, planning, execution, and sustainment).
* Act as the regional subject matter expert for system enhancements, carrier services, delivery capabilities, Partner Program services, and future fulfillment channels.
* Partner with Supply Chain and eCommerce Cluster teams to assess operational feasibility and establish sustainable operating models for new capabilities.
* Serve as the operational business point of contact for new carrier integrations and fulfillment capabilities.
* Cross\-Functional Governance \& Stakeholder Management
* Establish effective regional governance to provide transparent, audience\-tailored visibility into delivery performance, operational milestones, and risk mitigation.
* Collaborate closely with SCM and Warehouse teams to influence fulfillment and carrier performance, ensuring agreed service levels are met.
* Partner with Customer Service to identify recurring post\-order friction points and optimize processes for faster, more effective consumer issue resolution.
* Collaborate with eCommerce Platform Operations, CS, CX, Planning, Analytics, Service Management, and Partner Program teams to deliver end\-to\-end operational improvements.
* Data, Systems \& Operational Performance Management
* Utilize OmniHub, Kibana, and operational analytics tools to monitor order backlogs, track exceptions, evaluate performance, and conduct root\-cause analysis.
* Develop and maintain clear operational dashboards, reports, and structured governance routines.
* Partner with Digital Innovation and Product/Technology teams to translate operational requirements into scalable system and platform enhancements.
* Modernize Post\-Order Operations through simplification, automation, data insights, and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Explore AI\-driven opportunities across exception management, operational insights, predictive issue identification, workflow automation, and decision support.
* People Management \& Leadership
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of Post\-Order Operations professionals.
* Establish clear objectives, shared accountability, and transparent performance expectations across the team.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and consumer\-centric decision\-making.
* Provide steady, supportive leadership during high\-volume trading moments and dynamic operational conditions.


**Key Relationships**
* Cluster \& Hub SCM, Logistics, and Warehouse Teams
* Emerging Markets eCommerce Platform Operations, CS, Planning, CX, Analytics, and Partner Program
* Cluster eCommerce Leads and Teams
* IT Service Management Teams
* Digital Innovation and Programs Teams
* Global eCommerce \& Digital Product Teams


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* In\-depth understanding of the end\-to\-end eCommerce journey from click to delivery, including returns and reverse logistics.
* Strong knowledge of eCommerce post\-order operations, fulfillment workflows, and supporting technology architectures (OMS, WMS, TMS, and carrier platforms).
* Robust project management capabilities, including roadmap development, business requirements definition, milestone tracking, and operational handover.
* Strong understanding of processes at the intersection of business operations and IT systems.
* Proven ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and drive outcomes collaboratively across a matrix organization.
* A star in prioritization based on consumer, business, and operational impact, combining detail orientation with an action\-focused mindset.
* Demonstrated vendor management experience within eCommerce fulfillment.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical capabilities to monitor performance metrics and extract actionable consumer insights.
* Highly developed interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal) to engage effectively across organizational levels.
* High adaptability in navigating evolving business processes, priorities, and partner ecosystems under tight timelines.


**Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience delivering carrier/delivery service integrations and fulfillment capability rollouts.
* Extensive working experience with Microsoft Excel, Order Management Systems (OMS), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and Transportation Management Systems (TMS).
* Proven experience driving process optimization, workflow automation, and technology\-enabled operational transformation.
* Familiarity with practical AI applications within eCommerce operations is highly desirable.
* University degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Customer Service Manager Infrastructure & Datacenter Services
description:
The Customer Service Manager is accountable for managing the end\-to\-end relationship between Infrastructure and Datacenter Services and its internal customers, business stakeholders, technology teams and external service providers. The role ensures that customer requirements are understood, service commitments are delivered, transformation initiatives are coordinated and service performance is transparently communicated. It acts as the primary interface for service governance, stakeholder satisfaction, risk management and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* **Customer Relationship Management \-**
* Act as the primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders consuming infrastructure and datacenter services.
* Understand business priorities, operational requirements, service expectations and transformation needs.
* Lead regular service reviews and translate customer feedback into measurable improvement actions.
* Manage expectations through timely, clear and transparent communication



  




* **Service Management \& Performance \-**
* Oversee service delivery and performance against agreed service levels, operational commitments and customer expectations.
* Coordinate resolution of significant service issues, recurring incidents and cross\-functional operational challenges.
* Ensure clear ownership and closure of risks, issues, escalations and corrective actions.



 Confirm operational readiness, support models and documentation before new services are introduced.
 


* **Infrastructure Transformation \-**
* Coordinate customer engagement, readiness and adoption for Citrix, MFA, operating system, backup, cloud, hosting, security and datacenter transformation initiatives.
* Validate requirements, feasibility, dependencies, deployment plans and business impacts with all affected stakeholders.
* Maintain an integrated infrastructure roadmap covering milestones, releases and country deployments



  




* **Governance, Reporting \& Financials:**
* Lead service governance meetings and support steering committees.
* Produce executive and operational reports, dashboards, KPIs and action trackers.
* Track service costs, project budgets, forecasts and financial performance.
* Escalate material service, delivery, financial and supplier risks through the appropriate forums.



  




* **Stakeholder \& Supplier Management \-**
* Coordinate Infrastructure, Datacenter, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Operations, Architecture, Finance, Procurement and regional teams.
* Manage relationships with service providers, technology vendors and implementation partners.



 Monitor supplier performance against contractual and operational commitments and facilitate cross\-party issue resolution.
 



  





**Quality \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Develop and maintain service improvement plans based on performance trends, customer feedback and operational priorities.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, consolidate and optimize infrastructure services and processes.
* Promote consistent IT service management, project governance, documentation and control practices.



  





**Service Outcomes** 



* Achievement of agreed service levels and customer commitments.
* Timely resolution of customer escalations, recurring incidents and systemic service issues.
* Successful customer readiness and adoption for infrastructure transformation initiatives.
* Accurate, timely and decision\-oriented service, financial and risk reporting.
* Delivery of agreed service improvement actions and measurable improvements in reliability, efficiency and governance maturity.



  





**Required Skills:** 




  




* 10 years of experience
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* ITIL certification preferred; PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management qualification desirable.
* Experience in customer service management, IT service delivery, infrastructure operations or a related technology management role.
* Experience managing infrastructure, cloud, hosting, workplace or datacenter services and transformation initiatives.
* Experience working with managed service providers, technology vendors and geographically distributed stakeholders.
* Experience in large international organizations with complex IT landscapes.
* Infrastructure and datacenter operations; service performance and SLA management; project and portfolio coordination.
* Service transition, operational readiness, risk and escalation management, budget tracking and KPI reporting.
* Change management, vendor governance, contract performance and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity, identity, virtualization, backup, cloud migration and infrastructure modernization.
* Strong customer orientation, stakeholder management, communication, facilitation and negotiation.
* Ability to translate technical topics into clear business language and influence without direct authority.
* Analytical thinking, structured problem solving, organization and prioritization.
* Ability to work effectively across international, multicultural and cross\-functional environments.
* Proactive, accountable, collaborative and continuous\-improvement mindset.

title: FinCrime Senior Manager
description:
**About The Company**
 Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
   

  

 We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
   

  

 Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade\-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
   

  

 Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018\. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
   

  

**About The Role**
 In this role, you'll own FinCrime Operations end to end — keeping Aspire compliant with regulatory requirements while mitigating financial crime risk. You'll lead a team of analysts, provide strategic insight to senior management, and drive the process improvements that make our financial crime risk management framework sharper and more efficient as we grow.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our FinCrime team protects Aspire and our customers from money laundering, sanctions exposure, offboarding risk, and other financial crime. Working closely with Compliance, KYC, and Fraud, FinCrime Ops builds and runs the monitoring controls that keep Aspire compliant and safe as we scale across markets.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Lead and manage the FinCrime Ops team, ensuring timely and thorough handling of cases in line with internal policies and regulatory guidelines
* Oversee a team of 8–12 analysts, tracking key operational metrics such as completion rates, quality assurance scores, turnaround times, customer interaction, and efficiency benchmarks
* Identify underperformance trends and build structured improvement plans, including coaching, upskilling, and performance management
* Design and enhance FinCrime Ops processes, balancing compliance requirements with operational efficiency
* Provide strategic recommendations to strengthen controls and mitigate risks related to money laundering, fraud, and other financial crimes
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders (KYC, Fraud, Compliance) to improve data collection, risk assessment, and reporting
* Collaborate with external partners to continuously improve how we work together
* Ensure FinCrime Ops processes align with industry best practices and global regulatory standards (AML, CFT, KYC)
* Identify trends and emerging risks in financial crime, surfacing insights to senior management for proactive risk management
* Develop and implement AI and automation strategies within FinCrime Ops to improve efficiency and accuracy
* Train and mentor your analysts, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development


**What You Need To Be Successful**
* 7\+ years of experience and 4\+ years of leadership experience in financial crime compliance, AML, KYC, risk management, or related fields within financial services or fintech
* Strong knowledge of AML/CFT regulations, financial crime typologies, and risk assessment methodologies
* Proven leadership skills, with experience managing operational teams and driving performance
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with strong attention to detail
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present findings and recommendations clearly
* Proficiency in compliance\-related tools, transaction monitoring systems, and data analytics
* Professional certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti\-Money Laundering Specialist) or equivalent
* Experience in fintech, digital banking, or financial services
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to evolving regulatory landscapes
* Has a strong grasp of artificial intelligence concepts and the ability to apply AI tools (e.g. Claude, n8n, etc.) and frameworks to solve real\-world problems at Aspire.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Homeie is building the consumer company for where you live.** 




  





 The first product is the smartest way to rent a home in India. You tell Homeie what matters once, and our AI understands your taste, searches and coordinates across a fragmented offline market, helps you see only the homes actually worth considering, and gets the transaction done, including ₹0 security deposit upfront. What takes weeks today should eventually feel like one really good afternoon.
 



  





 Over time, Homeie should help you rent a home, understand your housing history, know what matters around where you live, make every move easier than the last, and eventually help you buy your first home.
 



  






 We’ve raised 
 
**$750k** 

  from a stealth fund, whose backers include Abstract Ventures, Bain Capital and Long Journey. We are still a very small team, which means the people joining now will have an absurd amount of influence over what Homeie becomes.
 




  





**What will you do:** 



* Own how we get our first few hundred renters. Reddit, offices, partnerships, going on the ground, weird hacks nobody has tried. Whatever works.
* Figure out where the best supply actually comes from, how we work with those people, what incentives make sense, and how we consistently get great homes when a renter shows up.
* Visit broker offices in person, onboard brokers to Homeie and build trust with them over time. Do creative stuff here \- like hosting broker events to bring them together.
* Spending time on the ground with renters, brokers and partners instead of forming opinions from a spreadsheet.
* Work with engineering and product to turn things we repeatedly do manually into software.



  





**Who we're looking for:** 



* Strong spoken Hindi and English. You talk to brokers, owners, society guards and renters all day, and each needs a different version of you.
* You want to be on the ground, not at a desk
* You can make decisions on your own when a plan falls apart



  





**We're hiring two kinds of people:** 




 1\. Freshers: 2025 and 2026 pass\-outs
 


* Startup internship experience strongly preferred. If you have interned somewhere early and know what it feels like when the process doesn't exist yet and you have to build it, this role will make sense to you.



 2\. People with 1\-3 years of field, ops or service experience
 


* KAMs, City Ops, Fleet Ops or Field Ops at quick commerce, mobility, hyperlocal or home services companies.



  





**This role is not for you if:** 



* You want a fixed desk and predictable 10\-to\-6 hours
* You'd rather escalate a problem than solve it on the spot
* You need a clear process before you can start
* You don't enjoy spending your day in broker offices, societies and other people's homes

title: UTM Supervisor
description:
The UTM Supervisor shall report to the General Manager / UTM Operation Manager and shall be responsible for the planning, supervision, verification, and reporting of assigned projects. The UTM Supervisor and UTM Operator shall function as a measurement team and work in tandem during onboard operations to ensure measurements are carried out safely, efficiently, and in accordance with survey / client requirements.
   

  

**ROLES ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
* Lead the UTM team on ship\-board assignments
* Review survey requirements, measurement scope, and project specifications
* Prepare measurement plans and coordinate project execution
* Liaise with attending surveyors, vessel representatives, and other stakeholders
* Brief the UTM Operator on measurement requirements, work scope, and safety precautions
* Supervise and verify onboard measurement activities
* Confirm that measurement locations, extent, and coverage meet survey requirements
* Assess significant wastage, corrosion, pitting, deformation, or other abnormal conditions
* Prepare, review, and compile the UTM report
* Ensure all project records are complete and properly retained


**Requirements**
**KEY SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES:**
**Technical Skills \-**
* Ship structural Ultrasonic Thickness Measurement (UTM) and marine inspection
* Interpretation of Class, IACS and survey requirements for thickness measurement
* Preparation of UTM measurement plans, scope, locations and coverage
* Review and validation of UTM readings, measurement records and prepare final reports
* Understanding of ship structural arrangements and common deterioration mechanisms
* Application of measurement quality, calibration and traceability requirements
* Knowledge of relevant Ship\-board safety procedures


**Professional Skills**
* Proficiency in AutoCAD for reading and marking\-up ship structural drawings, measurement locations and UTM sketches
* Proficient in MS Office and digital reporting systems
* Plan and supervise UTM projects from preparation to reporting
* Lead and brief UTM Operators on scope, methods and safety
* Coordinate effectively with Class Surveyors, vessel personnel and clients
* Exercise judgement to accept, reject or require re\-measurement of readings
* Willingness and readiness for international travel, with valid passport and national CDC


**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:**
**Professional Experience**
* Minimum 5 years relevant experience in Ultrasonic Thickness Measurement and marine inspection
* Practical experience conducting and/or supervising UTM for special surveys on ships
* Experience with Class/IACS requirements preferred


**Education \& Qualifications**
* Graduate (any stream) or
* Diploma or Degree in Mechanical engineering or Naval Architecture
* ASNT Level II in Ultrasonic Testing (UT) or equivalent


**Benefits**
**About Anglo\-Eastern**
 Anglo\-Eastern is a global leader in independent ship management services. The Group manages over 700 vessels under full technical management, supports around 500 additional ships under crew management, and has overseen more than 1,000 newbuildings and conversions through its newbuilding supervision and project management divisions.
   

  

 Headquartered in Hong Kong, Anglo\-Eastern operates through a network of 30 offices across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, including wholly owned maritime training facilities. Our strength lies in our people: over 39,000 seafarers and 2,350 shore\-based employees who work together to support clients across ship types while building trust, driving performance, and shaping a better maritime future.
   

  

**Why join Anglo\-Eastern?**
* Join a globally respected company with a strong maritime heritage of over 50 years
* Work in an environment anchored in integrity, trust, and long\-term relationships
* Access continuous learning and structured career development across a truly global network
* Be part of a team committed to delivering excellence and shaping a better maritime future


 Join us today!

description:
Position Manager – Commercials (Accounts, EXIM, FEMA \& Licensing)
 



  





 Department: Accounts
 



  





 Location: New Delhi – Nehru Place
 



  





 About Nature Morte
 



  





 Nature Morte is one of India’s most internationally recognized contemporary art galleries, with a 25\-year history of placing Indian artists at leading global institutions, including Tate Modern, the Guggenheim, and the Centre Pompidou. Alongside the gallery, Nature Morte operates the Saat Saath Arts Foundation, home to India’s first international sculpture park, and SSA Advisory, its institutional art advisory practice. The organisation is currently in an active phase of international expansion, with new locations and programmes being developed globally.
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 The Manager – Commercials will be responsible for managing the organization's commercial accounting, with a strong focus on, import\-export (EXIM) documentation, FEMA compliance, and statutory licensing
 



 Key Responsibilities1\. Commercial \& Accounting Operations Manage commercial accounting related to procurement, sales, imports, and exports.
 



  




* Review and verify invoices, purchase orders, commercial contracts, and payment documents.
* Coordinate with internal departments for commercial approvals and documentation.
* Ensure accurate accounting of import/export transactions.
* Reconcile vendor and customer accounts related to commercial transactions.
* Support month\-end and year\-end financial closing activities.

* Ensure timely customs clearance and shipment documentation.
* Monitor Bills of Entry, Shipping Bills, Bill of Lading, Airway Bills, and related documents.

* Manage inward and outward remittances.
* Monitor export realization and import payments.
* Prepare documentation required by RBI and AD Banks.
* Support audits related to FEMA and foreign exchange transactions.

* Track validity of licenses and ensure timely renewals.
* Liaise with government authorities for approvals and compliance matters.

* Maintain proper documentation and records for audits.

 Minimum 15 years of experience in commercial finance, EXIM operations, FEMA compliance, and licensing.
 



  




* Strong knowledge of:Import \& Export documentation
* FEMA regulations
* RBI guidelines
* DGFT procedures
* Customs compliance
* GST related to imports/exports
* Banking documentation (LC/BG)
* Experience coordinating with customs authorities, freight forwarders, banks, and government agencies.
* Proficiency in tally, ERP systems and Microsoft Excel.
* Strong analytical, documentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




  





**Job Title** 

 : Operations Manager – Site Execution
 




 Department: Operations / Projects
 



 Location: Delhi NCR / Multiple Project Sites
 



  





**Office Location:** 

 Sultanpur
 




**About Us:** 





 At Metalia India, we are shaping modern design with our innovative metal façades and premium wooden flooring solutions. We collaborate with architects, designers, contractors, and developers to deliver world\-class projects. As we expand our presence, we are looking for a dynamic, driven, and travel\-ready sales professional who can represent both our verticals with passion and expertise.
 



**Job Summary** 


 We are looking for a hands\-on and experienced
 
**Operations Manager** 

 with a strong background in civil construction and site execution. The role will be responsible for independently managing medium\-scale projects from site mobilisation and execution through project closure and final handover.
 





 The candidate will manage site supervisors, contractors, labour teams, and coordinate with clients and internal teams to ensure projects are executed as per drawings, BOQs, quality standards, and timelines.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
* Mobilise and set up new project sites, ensuring complete site readiness before execution begins.
* Understand project drawings, BOQs, specifications, and execution methodologies.
* Oversee the installation and execution of façade, structural, and related architectural elements.
* Lead and manage site supervisors, contractors, and labour teams.
* Ensure discipline, productivity, quality, and accountability across project sites.
* Conduct regular site reviews and progress meetings with supervisors and contractors.
* Monitor and manage 2–3 project sites simultaneously.
* Ensure execution is carried out as per approved drawings, BOQs, quality standards, and project timelines.
* Identify project delays, technical challenges, and site\-level issues and resolve them proactively.
* Coordinate with internal Project, Design, Production, Purchase, and Site teams for smooth project execution.
* Maintain regular daily and weekly project progress reports for leadership.
* Coordinate with clients at project sites and handle execution\-related discussions professionally.
* Ensure alignment between client expectations, project requirements, and site execution.
* Take complete ownership of project closure and final handover.
* Ensure completion of snag lists and pending site activities before handover.
* Coordinate and close final project billing.
* Obtain signed project handover documentation from clients.
* Ensure all supervisors and contractors are properly managed and accountable for their respective site responsibilities.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience** 
* 6–12 years of experience in civil construction, structural execution, façade execution, or related site operations.
* Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering is mandatory.
* Strong understanding of medium\-scale construction and site execution projects.
* Proven experience in managing site supervisors, contractors, and labour teams.
* Experience handling multiple project sites simultaneously.
* Strong knowledge of drawings, BOQs, execution methodology, and project timelines.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Excellent coordination and client\-handling skills.
* Strong ownership and execution mindset with the ability to work independently.
* Good communication and reporting skills.
* Experience in metal façade or architectural envelope projects will be an added advantage.


**What We Are Looking For** 
* A hands\-on problem solver, not just a reporter.
* A leader who takes complete responsibility from site mobilisation to final handover.
* Someone who can independently manage teams, contractors, and multiple project sites.
* A professional who understands that execution quality directly impacts project success and brand reputation.
* Someone who is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, design\-led, and growing organisation.

title: Manager - People Services Operations
description:
**ERM** 
 is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organisations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
   

  

 The
 **Global Delivery Centre** 
 (GDC) in Gurugram is ERM’s global operating backbone. It delivers business enablement services in Finance, HR, IT, and Commercial Operations to ensure ERM’s global business runs seamlessly, efficiently, and consistently.
   

  

 At the GDC, you will:
   

  

* Be part of a hub that ensures ERM’s business continuity worldwide.
* Collaborate with colleagues across geographies to support global operations.
* Drive consistency, compliance, and efficiency in core functions.
* Work with digital, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to optimise how ERM operates.
* Work in shifts where required, depending on the role. As processes mature and automation increases, reliance on shifts will reduce.
* Why this role matters?


 As a
 **People Services Team Lead** 
 , you will support ERM's global delivery by leading the execution of HR operations and employee lifecycle processes while ensuring a consistent, high\-quality service experience for employees and managers globally. You will work within the
 **People Services team** 
 , partnering with HR Operations, Payroll, Recruitment, Finance, Global Mobility, and business stakeholders across regions to deliver accurate, compliant, and efficient people services. This role is critical to ensuring operational excellence, service quality, process standardization, and scalability of ERM's global people operations model.
   

  

* What your impact is?
* Lead and develop a high\-performing People Services team that consistently delivers excellent service and achieves operational KPIs.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant processing of employee lifecycle transactions across multiple regions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service delivery, efficiency, and employee experience.
* Maintain high levels of data accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Support effective workload management, SLA adherence, and resolution of escalated employee and manager queries.
* Promote collaboration across HR Operations, Recruitment, Payroll, Finance, and Global Mobility teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
* What you'll bring:

title: Regional Clinical Trial Manager – (Unblinded Lead and Start-up Specialist)
description:
**Job Title: Regional Clinical Trial Manager – (Unblinded Lead and Start\-up Specialist)** 




**Location: Gurugram, India** 




**Reports to: Associate Director, Clinical Trial Management** 




  





*Help IAVI translate science into global health impact as a Regional Clinical Trial Manager!* 




*IAVI is seeking a Regional CTM, India, who will be responsible for the day\-to\-day operational activities enabling the conduct of clinical trials according to ICH/GCP guidelines. The role will work closely with the Global CTMs, cross\-functional study teams, clinical research sites and CROs to support unblinded activities, study start\-up and other operational coordination where applicable.* 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Unblinded CTM:** 




 Serve as the unblinded lead for assigned blinded studies ensuring appropriate handling and documentation of unblinded information and maintaining the integrity of the study blind. The responsibilities may include but not be limited to:
 


* Reviewing unblinded monitoring visit reports (MVRs) and working with the CRA to finalize reports within the deadline set in the study Monitoring Plan
* Cross\-checking information in the unblinded MVR with the randomization list for each study
* Leading or supporting investigations into deviations that involve unblinded data
* Filing unblinded documents in the TMF and performing reconciliations of unblinded documents in each study TMF as required by the Document Management Plan
* Reviewing laboratory test results or other study information that may be unblinding
* As required, liaising with the IAVI Manufacturing and clinical research sites to enable adequate and timely IP supplies at sites








**Study Start\-up:** 



* Perform study start\-up activities as assigned by the Clinical Trial Manager or Director, Clinical Operations. These may include but not be limited to:
* Coordinating site feasibility questionnaires and collating responses
* Liaising with selected sites to collect required documents for regulatory and ethics submissions
* Review site\-specific informed consent documents to ensure all essential elements are included and study\-specific information is accurately covered as per the Master Informed Consent Document
* Reviewing site SOPs to ensure they adequately cover GCP requirements and are fit for purpose for the trial
* Reviewing site source documents and tools to be used in the study
* Coordinating and supporting identification and resolution of site start\-up issues. Escalate any risks and document decisions.
* Developing and maintaining study start\-up trackers and site\-activation timelines
* Maintaining oversight of assigned study start\-up documentation and ensuring timely filing in the Trial Master File (TMF)
* Contribute to internal IAVI study plans (e.g., Monitoring Plan, Risk Management Plan)
* Assist CTM in establishing study timelines for clinical aspects of trials
* Provide study status updates to project team and management as needed.



  





**Other duties:** 



* May be assigned one or more sites to monitor (either blinded or unblinded)
* May participate in Clinical Operations departmental activities as assigned, including drafting or reviewing operational procedures, tools and templates
* Participate in departmental and cross\-functional meetings as appropriate
* Share relevant operational knowledge and lessons learned across Clinical Operations team



  





**Education and Work Experience:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or related field is required.
* Minimum 5 years of clinical trials experience including clinical monitoring is required.
* Clinical team lead experience is preferred.
* Experience supporting multinational or global clinical trials, preferably in sponsor, CRO, or public health settings, is highly desirable.








**Qualifications and Skills:** 



* Excellent knowledge of ICH GCP and FDA CFR guidelines as well as the Declaration of Helsinki and relevant country specific regulations are required.
* Interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a cooperative and collaborative manner with all levels, and across functional teams both internally and externally is required.
* Ability to work on problems of moderate complexity and diverse scope using good judgment within defined procedures and policies to determine appropriate action is required.
* Excellent project planning, organization and implementation skills in a cross\-disciplinary and multi\-cultural environment.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills are required.
* Proven ability to coordinate and lead multi\-disciplinary project teams is required.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently in a global, matrixed environment.
* A professional demeanor, as well as a pleasant manner and positive “can\-do” attitude.
* Flexible and adaptable to accommodate changing deadlines to meet organizational needs is required.
* Experience working with electronic TMFs and Clinical Trial Management Systems is required.
* Excellent computer skills and proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel is required.
* High level of independence in performing responsibilities is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with HIV, TB, emerging infectious diseases..
* Ability and willingness to collaborate effectively across time zones and geographic locations is required.
* Ability to travel internationally as required for study activities.



  





**Organizational Overview:** 




  





 IAVI is a nonprofit scientific research organization dedicated to addressing urgent, unmet global health challenges including HIV and tuberculosis. Our mission is to translate scientific discoveries into affordable, globally accessible public health solutions. Through scientific and clinical research in Africa, India, Europe, and the U.S., IAVI is pioneering the development of biomedical innovations designed for broad global access. We develop vaccines and antibodies in and for the developing world and seek to accelerate their introduction in low\-income countries. IAVI programs and partnerships are grounded in the regions of the world where the disease burden is the greatest, and our approach emphasizes sustainability. Our network of clinical research center partners in Africa and India helps strengthen in\-country research capacity and supports the training and education of the next generation of scientists. The global impact of our science includes fundamental contributions to understanding the biology of HIV infection, which IAVI and others are applying toward advancing vaccine science and immunology. IAVI accelerates scientific discovery and development by fostering unique collaborations among academia, industry, local communities, governments, and funders to explore new and better ways to address public health threats that disproportionately affect people living in poverty. Our global reach, including a clinical research network in five countries in sub\-Saharan Africa and in India, has allowed us to make fundamental contributions to understanding the epidemiology, transmission, virology, and immunology of HIV. This work played a key role in facilitating the design of promising HIV vaccine candidates, as well as the discovery of broadly neutralizing antibodies that are now being advanced as promising approaches for HIV prevention. Our integrated capabilities in vaccine and antibody discovery, development, and clinical research take advantage of bio\-pharmaceutical industry expertise to accelerate the development and testing of prevention methods for HIV and other diseases. Through the Product Development Center, we support external researchers with technical and scientific expertise to accelerate the development of their own products.
 




  





**IAVI CORE VALUES:** 



* Commitment: We deliver on our mission, proactively transforming promises into tangible results
* Stewardship: We steward IAVI's resources responsibly to ensure IAVI's long\-term success and global health impact
* Integrity: We uphold strong moral principles to maintain our credibility as a nonprofit scientific research organization
* Collaboration: We work as one IAVI team and partner with others to deliver globally accessible, urgently needed, public health solutions

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and skills required of personnel so classified. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an “at\-will” relationship. IAVI is an equal opportunity employer and applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Compensation And Benefits Information:** 




  





 Salary is paid in local currency, and is commensurate and competitive with the local labor market. Please note, there may be some variation based on experience level. In addition, this position offers competitive benefits including: generous retirement savings plan employer contributions; competitive health, dental and vision insurance plans; competitive paid time off policy; potential for annual bonuses based on performance; and other benefits.
