 .
 








 We are registered with
 **Ministry of Health, India,** 
 Pharmaceutical Export Promotion Council of India 
 **(Pharmexcil)** 
 and
 **Delhi Chamber of Commerce.** 
 Our group company has been into pharmaceutical distribution for over 50 years now and is
 **an authorized supplier for Ministry of Defence, India.** 




  





**Assistant Manager – Pharma Warehousing \& Cold Chain Logistics** 




**Overview** 




 The job requires an individual to manage the receipt, warehousing and export dispatch of pharmaceutical products (finished formulations) as per Pharma GDP norms. The candidate has to ensure adequate cold chain and ambient temperature export packaging for all shipments. Additionally, the candidate has to coordinate with freight forwarders / CHAs and transport vendors for export logistics and ensure that the shipment reaches the destination safely, within expected timelines. To sum up, the candidate shall support and facilitate the timely delivery of quality finished goods to customers, the efficient and safe storage of the Company’s finished goods inventory, and the effective management of inventory.
 



  





**Major responsibilities include:** 




 \-       Supervising the receipt of Goods and checking if in proper condition, as per required temperature and physical goods details matching with Supplier Invoice.
 



 \-       Proper stacking and storage of goods, as per the required product temperature, to prevent any product damage.
 



 \-       Understanding the required cold chain packaging along with data logger aspects and ensuring that the goods are packaged accurately and adequately as per the Export Invoice / Packing List for shipping and end\-to\-end temperature maintenance.
 



 \-       Ensuring the complete set of documents have been prepared for customs clearance.
 



 \-       Coordinating with transport vendor for timely arrival of Reefer / Transport vehicle, safe loading / unloading of goods and smooth handover of the goods at the respective ports, resolving customs clearance issue, arrangement of AWB, etc.
 



 \-       Conduct the final quality inspections on all outgoing warehouse stock.
 



 \-       Monitoring the shipment till it reaches the destination.
 



 \-       Communicating and coordinating with internal billing personnel to share the precise dimensions and weight aspects of the goods to be shipped, to ensure close estimation of the shipping charges.
 



 \-       Planning and coordination with procurement and sales team, as and when required.
 



 \-       Vendor screening \& Freight Negotiation, as per the Cargo requirement.
 



 \-       Ensure all forms as per SOPs are filled on a timely basis and MIS is provided as per management requirement.
 



 \-       Maintaining adequate operational records to assist the accountant, in checking 3PL and freight forwarder bills accurately.
 



 \-       Efficiently utilize warehouse space, materials and equipment, appropriately secure warehouse facilities and ensure that the warehouse is clean, tidy, orderly and maintained in accordance with acceptable housekeeping standards.
 



 \-       Ensuring that all warehouse equipment including medical refrigerators, air conditioners are in good working condition and taking corrective action at the earliest, in case necessary.
 



 \-       Efficiently plan and coordinate the scheduling of the expeditious delivery of products to customers in accordance with relevant delivery schedules as well as maintain a means to track product quality, quantity and costs.
 



 \-       Prepare and submit reports on all aspects of the warehousing and dispatching operations to the management.
 



 \-       Develop and maintain a consultative communication system with sales personnel and subordinate team members for the purpose of reviewing operating policies, plans, human and equipment performance\-related problems and initiating creative solutions to address/correct deficiencies.
 



 \-       Cost effectively coordinate and manage transport contractors and freight forwarders for export shipment.
 



 \-       Follow\-up on internal and external CAPA’s/investigations.
 



 \-       Facilitating external audits of warehouse operations.
 



  





**Skills required:** 




 \- At least 5 years of experience in warehouse management, packaging and logistics of cold chain goods or temperature sensitive products in a pharmaceutical / biomedical / in\-vitro diagnostics organization OR a pharmaceutical logistics company is mandatory.
 



 \- Advanced level of proficiency in understanding of Cold Chain temperature maintenance, adequate pharma packaging, as per Pharma GDP norms. Prior experience / exposure of GDP / GMP audits will be preferred.
 



 \- Responsible, punctual and organized individual with attention to detail required.
 



 \- Problem solver in an uncertain circumstances and ability to behave and plan the operations in a careful and risk mitigating manner.

title: Head of Operations
description:
Pasban \- The Gatekeeper is hiring a Head of Operations: total accountability for how every Pasban hotel actually runs.
 



  





 We operate nine boutique and experiential hotels today \- wildlife lodges, nature and wellness retreats, and heritage properties, most of them in offbeat destinations away from the metros \- and expect to reach twenty\-five to thirty properties within the next eighteen months. The corporate office in New Delhi is deliberately lean and senior; the depth sits at unit level, where each property carries its own operating team.
 



  





 This role reports to the Founder and owns the operating result of the group. Unit General Managers and Operations Managers run their hotels; this role directs, supports and holds them to account. It is equally a desk role and a road role \- the operating picture is formed at the properties, not from a report.
 



  





 What you'll own
 



  





 \- Portfolio operations: direct every property through its General Manager or Operations Manager, set the reporting discipline (daily flash, weekly operating call, monthly review), and hold each unit to its occupancy, service, cost and compliance commitments
 



 \- P\&L and profit delivery: monthly unit P\&L reviews with GMs and Finance, gross operating profit against budget, and recovery actions you verify were executed
 



 \- Budgets, cost control and capex: annual operating budgets, manpower cost to revenue, F\&B cost, energy, contracts and repairs; capital expenditure and FF\&E prioritised against the return it produces
 



 \- Brand and operating standards: own the SOPs for every department, run scheduled audits and unannounced checks, and close the gaps so every Pasban hotel feels unmistakably like a Pasban hotel
 



 \- Guest experience and reputation: review score targets by property across Google, TripAdvisor and the OTAs, response and service recovery protocols, and feedback read for patterns rather than incidents
 



 \- Purchasing and supply chain: group procurement policy, annual rate contracts negotiated at portfolio scale, and reliable supply into remote properties
 



 \- Statutory, safety and risk: every licence current \- trade, FSSAI, bar and excise, fire, pollution, tourism and municipal \- plus safety drills, hygiene discipline, insurance and crisis protocol
 



 \- People: staffing grids by property and season, selection panels for General Managers and department heads, training calendars and succession
 



 \- Pre\-openings: the operational critical path from handover to opening, ready on the committed date and to standard from the first guest
 



 \- Owner relations: monthly performance reporting, owner meetings, and honest handling of the difficult conversations
 



  





 Who we're looking for
 



  





 \- 12\-18 years in hotel operations, including tenure as a General Manager carrying full P\&L responsibility
 



 \- Multi\-property, cluster or area experience strongly preferred
 



 \- Boutique, experiential, resort or remote\-location operating experience is more relevant here than large city\-hotel experience alone
 



 \- Degree or diploma in Hotel Management (IHM or comparable), with genuine depth in both rooms and F\&B \- not a specialist in one and a passenger in the other
 



 \- Comfortable with property management, point\-of\-sale, channel and reporting systems
 



 \- Appetite for the road: this role is expected to spend a substantial share of each month at the properties
 



  





 Why this role
 



  





 \- Direct founder access. Decisions are made in days, not through committees
 



 \- The standards, cadence and controls for a thirty\-hotel group are yours to set now
 



 \- Regional structures and a larger operating organisation follow the portfolio
 



 \- Hotels in places most people travel a long way to see, and teams worth building
 



  





 Base location: Pasban Corporate Office, New Delhi. Scope is pan\-India, across all operating properties and pre\-opening projects. Travel is extensive.
 



  





 Compensation is commensurate with experience and benchmarked to the seniority of the role.
 



  





 Selection process: telephonic or video discussion, in\-person meeting with the Founder in New Delhi, property visit, reference checks, offer.
 



  





 Pasban is an equal opportunity employer. We select on capability, judgment and character.

**About Us:** 




  






 We are B2B Travel Tech startup that is reshaping the way travel agents sell and deliver exceptional travel experiences worldwide. We enable travel agents to book flights, hotels \& holidays conveniently and we provide comprehensive end\-to\-end on\-ground travel services.
 
**We do over INR 1000 crore\+ GMV (sales) and are growing rapidly.** 




  






 Our strong business model and focus on delivering excellent customer experience has facilitated our sustainable growth funded by internal cashflows.
 
**To fuel innovation and growth, we have raised USD 5\.5mn\+ funds from marquee global investors!** 




  





**Our Founding Team** 




  






 • Arun Bagaria – Co\-founder, Product — Ex\-Cars24, TravelTriangle, TripFactory \| IIM Bangalore
 





 • Chirag Agrawal – Co\-founder, Business — Ex\-OYO, TravelTriangle \| IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Roorkee
 





 • Ashish Thapliyal – Co\-founder, Technology — Ex\-CTO Cars24 \| CTO FabFurnish \| Gaadi
 




  





**What do we value?** 




  




* **We are a team of believers.** 

 At the same time, we are constantly learning and growing. We are on an audacious mission and have a rock\-solid belief we can get there.
* **We dream big,** 

 yet we start small and start quickly. We are not deterred by the extra effort needed to relentlessly execute, iterate, and execute to realise our dreams.
* **We are a team of differentiated and ambitious individuals** 

 , united by a common goal. We are a single team, where every member is important.
* **We believe flexibility in** 

 roles and freedom to execute ideas are the two foundational values for aggressive growth.
* **We constantly protect and** 

 evolve our culture. As a super energetic and experienced team, we want to enjoy the time we spend together.



  





**Our philosophy is simple :** 

 when travel agents grow, we grow with them.
 




  





**Your Mission** 




  






 Build and strengthen TravClan’s international DMC network so that our travel partners receive competitive rates, reliable service and strong on\-ground support. Own DMC sourcing, contracting, commercial performance and escalations end\-to\-end.
 




  





**Roles \& Responsibilities\-** 




  






 • Identify, evaluate and onboard relevant hotels/ transporters/ attractions/ suppliers across priority and emerging destinations \- domestic and international.
 





 • Build alternate supplier options to reduce dependency and improve destination coverage and resilience.
 





 • Negotiate rates, credit, payment and cancellation terms, group or series pricing and value additions.
 





 • Own contracts, renewals and accurate communication of current commercial terms to internal teams.
 





 • Benchmark rates and supplier capabilities to improve competitiveness, margins and service reliability.
 





 • Track vendor performance across response TAT, confirmations, service quality, refunds and adherence to commitments.
 





 • Own disputes and service failures through closure; renegotiate, reduce allocation or replace vendors where performance remains weak.
 




  





**What is on Offer ?** 



* Direct ownership of strategically important DMC relationships.
* Visible impact on holiday competitiveness, margins and service reliability.
* High autonomy and merit\-based growth.
* Competitive compensation of about 10\-35 LPA (80% fixed and 20% variable)



  





**Growth Path:** 



* GM/Director \- 35\-50 LPA
* Head \- 18\-35 LPA
* Manager \- 10\-18 LPA
* Associate \- 5\-10 LPA



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




  






 • 3\+ years in DMC contracting, domestic/ outbound holidays, supplier management or travel contracting.
 





 • A credible active supply network across key outbound destinations.
 





 • Demonstrated rate, margin or credit\-term improvements through negotiation.
 





 • Strong understanding of hotels, transfers, sightseeing, activities and ground services.
 





 • Commercially sharp, persistent and confident holding vendors accountable.
 





 • Able to work independently and drive difficult issues to closure.
 




  





**You will Thrive in This Role If....** 




  






 • You enjoy destination sourcing, benchmarking and difficult negotiations.
 





 • You build strong vendor relationships without compromising accountability.
 





 • You stay with a commercial or service issue until closure.
 




  





**This Role May not be the Right Fit if you.** 




  






 • You view vendor management mainly as relationship coordination.
 





 • You are uncomfortable pushing back on rates or service commitments.
 





 • You prefer maintaining current vendors rather than finding stronger alternatives.
 




  





**The Recruitment Process:** 




  





**1\. Personal Interviews:** 

 2\-3 video interviews. Detailed discussions about the job profile, company \& candidature are discussed in these rounds.
 




**2\. Extending an offer** 

 : On successfully clearing the interview rounds, the job offer is extended to the candidate. This includes financial benefits and many other benefits.
 




  





**Important Points** 




  





**Location** 

 : Connaught Place, New Delhi
 





 Work Schedule:
 
**You are considering joining a startup. Building anything of value takes time.**

title: D2C Ecommerce Manager (From Myntra or Shopify)
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 A fast\-scaling D2C (Direct\-to\-Consumer) consulting firm operating across India’s high\-growth consumer brands, we help emerging \& established brands architect, launch, and scale their digital commerce engines. Specializing in omnichannel retail strategy, we partner with founders and marketing teams to build profitable, data\-driven D2C flywheels — leveraging platforms like Shopify, Myntra, and native e\-commerce tooling to drive customer lifetime value and conversion velocity.
 **Role \& Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end D2C commerce strategy — from storefront architecture and conversion funnel design to post\-purchase retention \& lifecycle automation.
* Optimize Shopify/Myntra brand stores for maximum conversion rate, AOV, and customer retention using heatmap tools, A/B testing, and behavioral analytics.
* Own P\&L for client D2C operations: drive CAC efficiency, CLTV growth, and ROAS through paid/organic channel mix optimization.
* Collaborate with UX, creative, and product teams to align visual merchandising, on\-site messaging, and product storytelling with performance KPIs.
* Deploy and manage commerce tech stack: Shopify Plus, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Postscript, Google Analytics 4, and custom checkout flows.
* Run weekly performance deep\-dives, present insights to stakeholders, and translate data into actionable growth playbooks.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Must\-Have**
* Shopify
* Myntra Marketplace
* Google Analytics 4
* Klaviyo
* A/B Testing
* Conversion Rate Optimization
* Customer Journey Mapping
* ROAS Optimization


**Preferred**
* Shopify Plus
* Postscript SMS
* Looker Studio or Tableau


**Benefits \& Culture Highlights**
* Work directly with C\-suite founders and brand leaders — your strategy directly impacts revenue and scale.
* Flexible, outcome\-driven culture with autonomy to experiment and own results.
* Access to premium tools, training budgets, and exposure to 10\+ D2C brands across fashion, beauty, and FMCG sectors.


 Skills: optimization,ecommerce,d2c,customer,conversion rate,shopify,commerce,strategy,analytics

title: Associate Director- New Delhi
description:
****Overview****
**About the Organisation**
 Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
   

  

 Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Common Cancer, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
   

  

****About The Program****
 The Cancer, NCD and Mental Health portfolio aims to strengthen India's response to the growing burden of non\-communicable diseases by supporting governments to design, implement and scale sustainable models of prevention, early detection, diagnosis, treatment and survivorship.
   

  

 The portfolio currently supports programs across common cancers (breast, cervical, oral and lung cancers), chronic NCDs, mental health, comprehensive primary healthcare, digital health, implementation research, market shaping and health systems strengthening. The program works closely with national and state governments, development partners, academia, professional bodies and the private sector to develop scalable models that contribute towards India's National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non\-Communicable Diseases (NP\-NCD).
   

  

****About The Position****
 The Associate Director provides strategic, technical and operational leadership for Jhpiego India's Cancer, control portfolio. The position is responsible for shaping the overall program strategy, developing new business opportunities, ensuring high\-quality implementation across multiple states, strengthening partnerships with governments and donors, managing large multidisciplinary teams, and driving innovation and evidence generation.
   

  

 The position will play a critical role in positioning Jhpiego as a national leader in comprehensive Cancer control and NCD programming by integrating service delivery innovations, digital technologies, implementation science, health financing approaches and public\-private partnerships.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
**Strategic and Technical Leadership**
* Provide strategic vision and technical leadership for Jhpiego's Cancer and NCD portfolio across India.
* Develop long\-term strategic plans aligned with national priorities and global commitments on cancer care continuum and NCD control.
* Provide strategic guidance on implementation of WHO and Government of India guidelines for cancer screening and NCD management.
* Lead the design of innovative service delivery models across prevention, screening, diagnosis, treatment, survivorship and palliative care.
* Support development of national and state operational guidelines, SOPs, training packages and quality standards.
* Promote integration of digital health, AI\-enabled diagnostics, telemedicine and innovative technologies into program implementation.
* Identify emerging opportunities and position Jhpiego as a preferred technical partner for governments and development agencies.
* Provide strategic oversight for integration of common cancers into Comprehensive Primary Health Care platform.


**Program Management, Budgets, and Donor Compliance**
* Manages program work plans, budgets, and donor deliverables, ensuring compliance with philanthropic and institutional requirements.
* Oversees risk management and ensures timely, high\-quality delivery against agreed milestones.
* Provide oversight of multiple national and state\-level projects within the Cancer and NCD portfolio.
* Ensure timely achievement of project deliverables, quality standards, donor compliance and contractual obligations.
* Lead annual work planning, budgeting, forecasting and financial monitoring.
* Oversee program risk management and ensure effective mitigation strategies.
* Monitor portfolio performance through data\-driven decision making and adaptive management.


**Government and Partnership Engagement**
* Build and strengthen strategic partnerships with the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, National Health Mission and State Governments
* Engage with national technical institutions, professional societies, academic organizations and regulatory bodies.
* Representing Jhpiego in national technical working groups, policy forums and advisory committees.
* Strengthening collaborations with private healthcare providers, diagnostic companies, pharmaceutical, diagnostic partners and civil society organizations.
* Develop strategic partnerships with multilateral agencies, bilateral donors and philanthropic organizations.


**Team Leadership, Capacity Development, and Evidence Generation**
* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary technical and program teams across multiple states.
* Support recruitment, performance management and professional development.
* Stewards the evidence\-generation agenda, including analytical notes, research engagement, and the use of evidence to inform program direction.


****Knowledge, Skills And Competencies****
* Strong technical knowledge of cancer prevention, screening, diagnosis, treatment pathways and survivorship.
* Comprehensive understanding of India's NP\-NCD programme and Ayushman Bharat initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of breast, cervical, oral and lung cancers, knowledge of integration opportunities within primary healthcare and understanding of digital health ecosystems and AI\-enabled healthcare innovations.
* Proven ability to manage program strategy, work plans, budgets, donor deliverables, and compliance.
* Demonstrated stakeholder and partnership management across government, professional societies, accreditation bodies, and international or regional partners.

title: IFS ERP Application LEAD (India)
description:
**Join Mexens (formerly Technique Solaire)**
 Founded in 2008, Mexens is a renewable energy producer specialising in solar, biogas, and wind power. We develop, finance, build, and operate energy production facilities across France and internationally.
   

  

 With over 250 employees, strong growth momentum, and international ambitions, we are now looking for an
 **Application Manager** 
 to strengthen our Perfomance, Transformation and Technology Department.
   

  

**Our Four Core Values**
**Join Us And Embody What We Stand For**
* Excellence: Always aiming for the highest level of quality and achievement in everything we do
* Proximity: Working as a team for greater day\-to\-day efficiency
* Sustainability: Building long\-term relationships and acting responsibly to protect the environment
* Ambition: Delivering outstanding results, staying ingenious and agile to always anticipate what's ahead


**Why We Need You**
 You will be joining a company in the midst of a significant IT transformation.
   

  

 As part of the
 **Performance, Transformation \& Technology** 
 team, you will play a central role within our business application ecosystem, primarily across the
 **Finance, Procurement, and Project Management** 
 domains.
   

  

 You will contribute to the smooth operation of the applications within your scope and participate in their evolution to improve performance and better meet user needs. Working closely with business teams, integrators, and software vendors, you will be involved in incident management, change tracking, and continuous improvement projects. You will also support users in adopting and making the most of our applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Configuration Management for our IFS ERP and related applications:**
* Assist and advise on the use of the application systems under your responsibility
* Ensure the quality and operational performance of the solutions you manage
* Coordinate corrective, preventive, and evolutionary maintenance


**Application Service Quality Management**
* Apply and enforce established standards, methods, and tools
* Keep the application landscape up to date (components, data flows, etc.)
* Ensure knowledge continuity and publish business procedures and technical notes in our knowledge base
* Broadly monitor the quality of service across technology solutions, identify gaps, and track continuous improvement initiatives


**Communication And Support**
* Act as the primary point of contact between the IT department and business users within your scope
* Prioritise and resolve Level 1 and 2 support requests on a daily basis for your applications
* Escalate requests to software vendors and/or integrators when necessary, ensuring incidents and issues are followed through to full resolution
* Serve as a key liaison with our technical infrastructure team to maintain operational readiness of solutions (security, access management, scalability, performance, etc.)
* Bring a coherent vision of business processes to the table and constructively challenge requests for additional configuration


**Business Analysis**
 You will contribute to writing functional and technical specifications to evolve the configurations within our application ecosystem. A solid
 **techno\-functional understanding** 
 of our ERP ecosystem is therefore required — including reference data, application interfaces, and data exchange flows.
   

  

**Your Future Team**
 You will be joining a team of
 **22 people** 
 spread across France, whose members will be delighted to welcome you and share their varied experiences and expertise.
   

  

**Lakshmi** 
 , your future manager, is the Application Programme Manager, and
 **Herizo** 
 , your future Director, is a member of the
 **Executive Committee** 
 . He holds a high level of professional standards and will actively support and recognise your contributions. Joining Mexens' Performance, Transformation and Technology Department means investing in a
 **long\-term career development plan** 
 within a department set to grow from two to around ten internal team members by 2035\.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
**Bachelor’s degree** 
 in
 **Computer Science or Information Technology. Master's would be a plus.**
**At least 3 years of hands\-on experience** 
 managing the
 **IFS ERP platform** 
 from a technical standpoint, complemented by solid functional knowledge.
   

  

 Ideally, you have worked within a
 **fast\-growing mid\-sized company** 
 or a
 **large international group** 
 of several thousand employees.
   

  

**Key Knowledge And Skills Required** 
 \- Software lifecycle management
 *(agile and/or hybrid)*
* ERP management, with specific expertise in the IFS product
* Exposure to SaaS solutions across the following domains:
* Payments and treasury management
* Tax reporting
* Document digitalisation and processing
* Similar solutions that complement an ERP through application interfaces (APIs)
* Fluent in English (Speaking and Writing): Ability to write support tickets for international stakeholders and leads meetings.
* A genuine ability to understand expressed needs and reformulate them clearly — both in writing and verbally — for diverse audiences, including Procurement and Finance teams
* Your manager will expect you to be autonomous, structured, humble, with a strong sense of priorities and team spirit


**Conditions**
 A competitive salary and an opportunity to work at a young, entrepreneurial, and a growing company, with plenty of room for your own initiatives and ideas.
   

  

**Ready to Take the Next Step?**
**Mexens is waiting for you 😊**
 Apply now by sending us your CV.
 *No cover letter needed* 
 — at Mexens, your career path speaks for itself.

title: Key Account Manager - CPC and Govt Accounts
description:
**How does this Job align to our Strategy?** 




  





 At the core of Tata Consumer Products' business approach lie six strategic pillars that serve as the foundation for its growth and success: Strengthening \& Accelerating our Core Business, Driving Digital and Innovation, Unlocking Synergies, creating a Future\-Ready Organization, Exploring New Opportunities and Embedding Sustainability. This job opportunity closely aligns with one of these key strategic pillars, which is driving Strengthen \& Accelerate core business and Unlock Synergies. The role involves delivering topline \& bottom\-line targets in line with business goals in the accounts, onboard new national accounts, drive activations across accounts \& be responsible for P\&L of the customers.
 



  





**What are the Key Deliverables in this role?** 




  





 🌟Develop the annual account plan (JBP), sales \& portfolio growth plan, new product launch plan and expense budgeting for the account / set of accounts in line with company business objectives
 



 🌟Drive the achievement of Volume and Value targets in CPC \& Govt channel
 



 🌟Continuously monitor, report, and take appropriate action along with quarterly performance review (Internal team/Accounts)

 🌟Coordinate with CPC \& Govt Team to ensure effective merchandizing across all CPC \& Govt canteens
 



 🌟Ensure high rate of account renewals with favorable terms of trade.
 



 🌟Identify \& onboard new national accounts and setup favorable terms of trade
 



 🌟Perform Innovation / NPD tracking \- listing \& business plan, Activation Plan (Customer Communication \& Implementation)
 



 🌟Leverage existing relationship with national accounts to drive proliferation of key brands across accounts.
 



 🌟Liaison with Innovation center resources to customize product basis customer/account needs.

description:
**Country Manager – (HVAC, Ventilation, IAQ, ERV/HRV, Heating\-cooling system)** 




**Zehnder Group \| Represented in India by T\&A Consulting** 




**Location: Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru** 




  





**About Zehnder Group** 




 Zehnder Group is a Swiss headquartered provider of world\-leading solutions for a comfortable, energy\-efficient and healthy indoor climate. The products and services of the Group include heating, cooling, indoor ventilation and air cleaning. The Group develops and manufactures its products at its own factories in Europe, China, and North America.
 



 As part of its international growth strategy, Zehnder is now entering the Indian market and is looking to appoint Country Manager – India.
 



**More about Zehnder Group on www.zehndergroup.com** 




 Zehnder has partnered with
 **T\&A Consulting** 
 to support its India market entry and leadership hiring.
 



  





**About T\&A Consulting** 




 T\&A Consulting is a global advisory firm, with extensive experience of working with government, economic development agencies, businesses and academic institutions across Europe, Asia, and the Americas towards their expansion in the international markets.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Country Manager – India who will be responsible for building Zehnder’s business in India from the ground up.
 



 This is not a conventional sales role. It is a
 **market\-entry, business development and category\-building role** 
 for a senior commercial professional who can create demand for premium indoor climate solutions in India.
 



 The role requires someone who can position Zehnder as a premium ventilation, fresh\-air and indoor air quality brand in India, build specification\-led demand, develop a strong project pipeline, create the right partner ecosystem, and secure early reference projects.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable operating in a lean, entrepreneurial setup where brand awareness, channels, installer capability and market acceptance need to be built from scratch.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. India Market Entry \& Business Build\-Up** 



* Establish Zehnder’s presence in India.
* Develop and execute a practical go\-to\-market plan for India.
* Identify priority customer segments, geographies and project types.
* Build Zehnder’s visibility among architects, consultants, developers, contractors and premium project decision\-makers.
* Generate qualified project pipeline and secure early reference projects.
* Provide regular market intelligence, competitor insights and customer feedback to Zehnder’s global leadership team.



  





**2\. Ventilation, Fresh\-Air \& Indoor Climate Business Development** 



* Lead market development for Zehnder’s balanced energy recovery ventilation systems
 **(ERV/ HRV, fresh air)** 
 with focus on the residential market.
* Build demand around the need for healthy indoor air, controlled ventilation, humidity management, energy efficiency and premium indoor comfort.
* Educate the market on the difference between air purification, air\-conditioning and engineered balanced energy recovery ventilation systems.
* Position Zehnder as a premium, technically superior and performance\-led indoor climate solution provider.



  





**3\. Premium / Luxury Project Sales** 



* Identify and develop opportunities in premium and luxury building projects.
* Target relevant segments such as luxury residential developments, branded residences, HNI villas, premium apartments, wellness spaces, high\-end hospitality, international schools, healthcare and select green building projects.
* Build relationships with premium developers, architects, interior designers, consultants, villa owners, project owners and HNI\-focused ecosystem partners.
* Sell on value, performance, comfort, health, acoustics, energy efficiency and lifecycle benefit, not on price alone.



  





**4\. Specification \& Project Sales** 



* Drive specification\-led selling by engaging architects, MEP consultants, HVAC consultants, green building consultants, PMCs, developers and contractors.
* Influence projects at the design and specification stage, before tendering and commercial negotiation.
* Develop technical presentations, concept notes and project\-specific value propositions.
* Support the creation of BOQ inputs, specification language, product comparisons, technical submittals and project proposals.
* Ensure that Zehnder is positioned as a system solution, not merely a product or equipment supplier.



  





**5\. Partner Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, evaluate and develop suitable channel partners, system partners, installers, integrators and commissioning partners.
* Build a limited but high\-quality partner network capable of selling, installing and servicing premium ventilation systems.
* Train partners on Zehnder’s product value proposition, installation standards, commissioning discipline and customer experience expectations.
* Ensure that partners have the capability to support premium projects and maintain Zehnder’s brand standards.
* Develop a partner model that protects pricing, service quality, installation quality and long\-term customer satisfaction.



  





**6\. Technical Selling \& Customer Education** 



* Explain Zehnder’s solutions convincingly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Communicate the benefits of balanced ventilation, fresh\-air supply, energy recovery, humidity control, filtration, low\-noise operation and indoor air quality.
* Conduct presentations, seminars, consultant meetings, architect discussions, CPD\-style sessions and industry engagements.
* Build awareness among the market that premium indoor climate is about air quality, comfort, health and performance \- not only cooling.



  





**7\. Brand Representation \& Executive Presence** 



* Act as the face of Zehnder in India.
* Represent the company in senior client meetings, industry forums, trade events, consultant interactions and partner discussions.
* Build credibility with Indian stakeholders while maintaining alignment with Zehnder’s European quality, brand and business standards.
* Communicate clearly with Zehnder’s global leadership team on India market realities, opportunities, challenges and progress.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





**Experience** 



* 10–15 years of experience in HVAC, ventilation, building technology, indoor air quality, air filtration, fresh\-air systems, ERV/HRV, heat recovery, energy recovery, related technical building solutions.
* Experience in premium or specification\-led project sales is strongly preferred.
* Prior exposure to international companies, European brands, premium technical products or MNC environments will be an advantage.
* Experience in building a new business vertical, product category, region, partner network or market from an early stage will be highly valued.



  





**Product / Sector Exposure** 




 The ideal candidate should have exposure to one or more of the following:
 


* **Balanced energy recovery ventilation systems (ERV/ HRV, fresh air)**
* **Residential ventilation systems**
* Heat recovery / energy recovery
* Indoor air quality solutions
* Air filtration / clean\-air solutions
* Premium HVAC systems
* Green building / energy\-efficient building solutions



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for a commercially strong, self\-driven professional with a builder mindset. The right candidate will be someone who has the maturity of working with international companies, but also the agility, ownership, and entrepreneurial drive required to build a business in a new market.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




 ▪ Strong business development and pipeline creation capability
 



 ▪ Ability to build markets, channels, and partnerships from the ground up
 



 ▪ Commercially sharp and opportunity\-driven
 



 ▪ Strong network in HVAC / ventilation / building technology ecosystem
 



 ▪ Good understanding of specification\-led and project\-led sales
 



 ▪ Ability to work independently with limited local infrastructure
 



 ▪ High ownership, initiative, and accountability
 



 ▪ Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
 



 ▪ Comfortable working with international leadership teams
 



 ▪ Strategic thinking with hands\-on execution capability
 



  





**Why This Role Is Exciting** 




 ▪ Opportunity to lead the India market entry for a respected European brand
 



 ▪ First commercial leadership role for Zehnder in India
 



 ▪ High ownership and visibility with global leadership
 



 ▪ Opportunity to shape market strategy, channel structure, and early business growth
 



 ▪ Ideal role for a professional who enjoys building, not just managing.

* Manager \- 10\-18 LPA
* Associate \- 5\-10 LPA



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




  






 • 5\+ years of experience in MICE sales, corporate travel, events or group travel, including meaningful business leadership.

 • Strong command of RFPs, contracting, pricing, margins, payment terms and collections.
 





 • Experience building and leading a high\-performance sales team.

 • You enjoy hunting for new business and owning ambitious targets.

 • You balance growth with profitability, cash flow and delivery feasibility.

 • Your experience is primarily in MICE operations rather than sales.

**What You'll Do**
* Opportunity identification on the ground: Continuously scan the operations to surface improvement avenues, inefficiencies, and performance gaps, and maintain a prioritized pipeline of opportunities backed by data and operational evidence.

title: Growth Manager - Enterprise Growth (Digital Commerce)
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 GobbleCube is an agentic growth operating system designed to help brands scale profitably across digital marketplaces. Founded in November 2022 by the ex\- core team of Blinkit, the platform went live commercially from private beta in September 2024\.
 



  





 Since then, GobbleCube has scaled rapidly, supporting 600\+ brands across enterprise and D2C, growing revenue 10X, and onboarding 45 of India’s largest CPG enterprises in just the last 9 months, including HUL, Nivea, Tata Consumer Products, ITC, Godrej, Beiersdorf, MTR, L’Oréal, Hershey’s, and many more.
 



  





 As commerce becomes more distributed and hyperlocal, GobbleCube is building agentic solutions to help brands navigate complexity in real time, across visibility, performance marketing, supply chain, and growth strategy. Headquartered in Gurugram, the company supports brands across India, MENA, and LATAM.
 



  





**About the role** 




 India's largest CPG brands do business worth hundreds of crores every year on Quick Commerce platforms. They lose share for reasons invisible from a 360 dashboard: a dark\-store availability gap, a competitor outbidding them on a category keyword, a discount ladder that buys volume at the cost of contribution margin.
 



 GobbleCube finds those reasons. Your job is to walk into the brand's boardroom, tell the CXO what is happening, recommend what to do about it, and get a room of senior people who might disagree to commit to a decision.
 



  





**What this role is not** 




 This is not a marketing growth role. No funnel, no CAC, no acquisition budget, and no performance campaigns to run. If you are a growth marketer, this isn't the job you want.
 



 This is also not a traditional Customer Success role. You are not measured on tickets closed, QBR decks delivered, or logins. Nobody here will ask you to "drive adoption."
 



 The closest analogue is what an MBB consultant does for a CPG client, except you do it under a productised strategic consulting environment, for India's largest CPG brands at once, with a product doing the work in the background.
 



  





**What you will actually do** 



* Run regular strategic connects (online and in\-person both) with each account's senior leadership. Not a status update. A point of view on their business, and recommendations backed by data, to drive their business objectives.
* Diagnose why an output metric moved: market share, offtake, margin, etc. Decompose it into availability, visibility, discounting and supply chain. Then decide what is worth acting on.
* Take a difficult position to a senior stakeholder and make it land. Frequently the recommendation is "stop doing the thing that makes your number this month."
* Build the quarterly impact story: problem identified, action recommended, outcome achieved, revenue or share impact, in the brand's own numbers.
* Find the next business problem worth solving, prove it in a pilot, and convert it into expansion revenue.
* Turn what worked on one account into a repeatable SOP or a product requirement, so the ninth account does not need a ninth person.



  





**Who you will be in the room with** 




 CMOs, Sales Heads, E\-commerce Heads, Supply Chain Heads, occasionally CFOs. They are senior, have limited face time, and each of them wants something different from the same budget. Their KAMs and brand managers are your day\-to\-day.
 



  





**What makes this different from consulting** 




 The dogwork is automated. RCA, data pulls, anomaly detection, competitive tracking, and most of the analysis run through the product and agentic workflows in the backend. You are deciding what the analysis means, what to recommend (the right action at the right time), and how to get it approved. That is also the bar. When the analysis is free, the analysis is not the value. Your judgement is.
 



  





**How you will be measured** 



* Net revenue retention across your portfolio. Zero downsell, plus expansion.
* A documented, quantified impact story per account per quarter.
* Pilot\-to\-conversion rate on expansion modules.
* Qualified expansion opportunities briefed to GTM with a written business case.
* No account goes Amber without you flagging it first.
* Strategic connect coverage and conversation quality across your book.



  





**You will do well here if** 



* You can hold your position when a senior stakeholder tells you your data is wrong, without either backing down or repeating "the data says so."
* You are comfortable being the least senior person in the room and still owning the recommendation.
* You end conversations with an owner, a decision, a metric and a review date, rather than with an action\-items list.
* You would rather be right in eight weeks than agreeable today.



  





**You will struggle here if** 



* You need a clean brief before you can start.
* You want analysis to be your main contribution.
* Confrontation with senior stakeholders drains you.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's from a Tier 1 institute (IIT, IIM, ISB and equivalent).
* 3\-7 years in management consulting, strategy and ops, growth, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS company. Consumer or retail exposure is a strong plus.
* Structured problem\-solving you can demonstrate live, not just describe.
* Presentation and stakeholder management skills at CXO level.
* Strong Excel. Enough SQL to interrogate an analysis and find the hole in it.

 Reporting \& Process Improvement

* Support digital procurement initiatives and ERP optimization projects.
* Drive continuous improvement in procurement processes and controls.

**Job Purpose**
 To take prompt and swift actions to mobilize ARFF resources during Aircraft Accident/ Incident, structural fires, other fires and incidents related to public health at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport in accordance with Aerodrome Emergency Plan, Standard Operating Procedures and coordinate with Air Traffic Control, Incident Commander, Command Post and Airport Operations Control Centre for effective incident management.

**Key Accountabilities**
 To test and ensure proper functioning of ARFF watch tower equipments and communications systems.

 To obtain report from Manager\- ARFF Operations/ Lead Firefighter Operations with regard to serviceability of all ARFF appliances and initiate defect rectification with concerned agencies and maintain the records.

 To maintain records of ARFF vehicular movements, aircraft incident/ accident, fuel spillage, structural fires and other incidents occurring within the jurisdiction of Rajiv Gandhi International Airport for the purpose of evidence and audits by the regulatory and certification authorities.
   

  

 To monitor the Building Management System console and CCTV system and to take necessary actions in case of any abnormality is noticed.

* Nil

* Graduate preferably with science subjects.

* Good Computer knowledge.
* Good communication skills.

title: Production Manager - Press Shop
description:
**Company Description** 
 Kiddery Babyworks designs and manufactures modern cradles, bassinets, and contemporary Montessori\-inspired kids’ furniture for homes and schools. The company focuses on safe, functional, and aesthetically pleasing products that support child development and family\-friendly spaces. All products are proudly designed and made in India, reflecting a commitment to local craftsmanship and quality. Kiddery Babyworks serves families and educational institutions seeking durable, thoughtfully designed furniture tailored to the needs of young children.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Production Manager – Press Shop is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Khanjhawala. This role oversees daily press shop operations, including planning and managing production schedules, allocating resources, and ensuring output meets quality, safety, and delivery standards. Responsibilities include supervising machine operators and technicians, monitoring equipment performance, coordinating maintenance, and resolving production issues to minimize downtime. The Production Manager will implement and improve standard operating procedures, maintain inventory of raw materials and tooling, and collaborate with design, purchasing, and quality teams to support new product introductions and continuous improvement. The role also involves tracking production metrics, preparing reports, and promoting a safe, organized, and compliant work environment.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Demonstrated experience in press shop or metal fabrication production management, preferably in furniture or consumer goods manufacturing.
* Strong skills in production planning, workflow optimization, and resource allocation within a manufacturing setting.
* Ability to supervise and develop shop\-floor teams, with a focus on performance, safety, and clear communication.
* Knowledge of press machines, tooling, preventive maintenance practices, and basic mechanical troubleshooting.
* Understanding of quality control procedures, safety regulations, and lean or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency with production reporting, basic data analysis, and the use of ERP or manufacturing management systems.
* Relevant technical or engineering qualification (e.g., diploma or degree in mechanical or industrial engineering) is preferred.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work on\-site full\-time in Khanjhawala.

title: Leather Production & Sourcing Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Orion Conmerx Private Limited is a leading manufacturer of high\-quality handcrafted leather apparel, bags, and accessories for international luxury brands, operating in India since 1993\. The company is SA8000, ISO 14001, and SMETA certified, reflecting a strong commitment to ethical practices, environmental responsibility, and sustainable supply chains. With advanced machinery, innovative product techniques, and a focus on product R\&D and operational excellence, Orion keeps pace with global fashion trends. A highly skilled workforce of around 1,500 professionals produces over 45,000 leather garments and bags per month, supported by in\-house tanneries and a global sourcing network across India, New Zealand, Africa, Saudi Arabia, and Europe. Orion is expanding with a state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facility in India, guided by experienced leadership focused on quality, efficiency, and long\-term growth.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Leather Production \& Sourcing Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi. This role is responsible for managing end\-to\-end leather sourcing from domestic and international suppliers, ensuring quality, cost\-effectiveness, and on\-time availability of raw materials and finished leather. The manager will oversee production planning for leather garments and bags, coordinate with tanneries and manufacturing teams, and monitor daily output, quality standards, and process efficiency. Day\-to\-day activities include vendor evaluation and negotiation, sample development coordination, documentation and compliance checks, and continuous improvement of production workflows. The role involves close collaboration with design, product development, procurement, and quality teams to align sourcing and production with brand requirements, sustainability goals, and delivery timelines.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong expertise in leather sourcing and procurement, including vendor management and negotiation with domestic and international suppliers.
* Hands\-on experience in leather production management, including planning, workflow optimization, and coordination with tanneries and manufacturing units.
* Solid understanding of leather types, tanning processes, finishing techniques, and quality control standards for premium fashion and luxury products.
* Knowledge of sustainability, ethical sourcing, and compliance frameworks, preferably with exposure to certifications like SA8000, ISO 14001, or SMETA.
* Proficiency in using production and inventory management tools or ERP systems, with strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with design, product development, and operations teams.
* Relevant academic background such as a degree or diploma in Leather Technology, Fashion Technology, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Prior experience in leather manufacturing or fashion accessories production, ideally in a high\-volume or export\-oriented environment.

title: Warehouse Operations Executive in Gurgaon, Delhi
description:
Art of Puja is looking for a responsible and hardworking Warehouse Manager / Warehouse Operations Executive who can take ownership of the day\-to\-day functioning of our warehouse. This is a hands\-on role. You will be responsible for maintaining inventory, managing inward and outward movement of goods, coordinating dispatches, supervising warehouse staff, and managing production and assembly work happening inside the warehouse.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who wants to learn, take responsibility, and grow with the company for the long term. You do not need fancy qualifications. We are looking for someone who is organised, sincere, disciplined, comfortable working on the warehouse floor, and capable of managing people and daily tasks.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage complete day\-to\-day warehouse operations.
* Maintain proper inventory and stock records for all products and materials.
* Handle all inward material entries and verify quantities received from vendors.
* Manage outward dispatches for B2B and B2C orders.
* Ensure orders are picked, packed and dispatched correctly and on time.
* Coordinate with courier partners and other teams regarding dispatch requirements.
* Maintain proper records of inward, production, outward, damages and stock adjustments.
* Conduct regular physical stock checks and identify any stock differences.
* Keep track of low\-stock and out\-of\-stock products.
* Manage warehouse workers, helpers, pickers and packers and assign their daily tasks.
* Supervise production, packing and assembly activities happening inside the warehouse.
* Ensure daily production targets are completed on time.
* Coordinate between inventory, production and dispatch teams.
* Maintain proper storage and rack\-wise organisation of products.
* Ensure the warehouse remains clean, organised and safe.
* Maintain daily reports for production, inventory and dispatches.
* Report delays, damages, shortages or other operational issues immediately.
* Take overall responsibility for ensuring smooth functioning of the warehouse.


 Why Join Art of Puja?
   

  

 Art of Puja is a growing spiritual lifestyle and gifting brand. As we scale our B2C, marketplace, quick\-commerce, and corporate gifting business, our warehouse and production operations are also growing rapidly. This role provides an opportunity to work closely with the core team, learn complete warehouse operations, and gradually take on larger responsibilities as the company grows. We are specifically looking for candidates interested in a stable, long\-term role rather than a short\-term job.
   

  

 About Company: Art of Puja is a modern D2C brand that bridges the gap between spirituality and contemporary living. Our mission is to revive and modernize ancient traditions by offering thoughtfully designed spiritual products for today's lifestyle. We believe in creating meaningful experiences for our customers, blending authenticity with elegance. If you're passionate about blending tradition with innovation and want to work in a fast\-growing, purpose\-driven environment, join us in building something truly impactful!

title: Category Manager
description:
**MERCHANDISING MANAGER \- HOME** 




 Function: Merchandising \| Location: New Delhi (Tulsi Farms) \| Reporting to: Chief Merchandising Officer
 



 Experience: 6\-9 years in Merchandising (minimum 3 years handling the Home category)
 



**Step Into the World of Nicobar** 




 Founded in 2016 by Simran Lal and Raul Rai,
 **Nicobar** 
 is a modern, mindful, design\-led lifestyle brand from India.
 



*“We wanted to create a new Indian sensibility that wasn’t necessarily Westernised.”* 




 We’re reimagining a contemporary Indian way of living, dressing, and looking at the world—rooted in culture, shaped by design, and guided by intention. At Nicobar, we believe in culture as much as commerce, and that how we build is just as important as what we build.
 



 Our studio is tucked away in Tulsi Farms, Chhatarpur, Delhi. Nestled among trees, seasonal gardens, a citrus grove, and our beloved dogs Nico \& Dot, we call it
 *“
 
 the Treehouse.
 
 ”* 
 It earned its name when our architect reworked the blueprint to protect every single tree on the land. It’s a space where creativity brims and energy flows.
 



 If you’re drawn to thoughtful design, a youthful and nourishing team culture, and the chance to grow a brand with heart—we’d love to hear from you.
 



**Follow our journey:** 

 Instagram
 
 \|
 
 LinkedIn
 
 \|
 
 Nicobar.com
 
 \|
 **Watch our Co\-founders, Raul \& Simran talking about Nicobar**




**Reach out to us through the below link \-** 
 📩
 **https://lnkd.in/gghFi5Yz**




**Your Role in the Story** 




 You are the commercial engine behind Nicobar’s Home category – owning the numbers, the range, and the results across tableware, drinkware, textiles, décor, and furniture. Reporting to the CMO, you sit at the intersection of data and intuition, analysing what is selling, anticipating what should, and working across planning, design, sourcing, and retail to keep the category commercially sharp season after season.
 



**Where You’ll Make Impact** 



* Own the commercial performance of Home – sell\-throughs, best and worst sellers, markdowns, and replenishment against seasonal targets.
* Drive the Home range plan with design and sourcing – balanced, seasonally relevant, and aligned to pricing architecture and occasion (everyday, entertaining, gifting, festive).
* Manage width, depth, and open\-to\-buy – balancing core replenishable lines against seasonal drops, and keeping inventory and stock cover healthy.
* Build the seasonal buy and forecast – size and phase orders by channel, set OTB by sub\-category, and manage in\-season re\-orders to protect margin.
* Own markdown, ageing, and terminal\-stock strategy – act early on slow sellers, plan exit routes, and keep provision and liquidation under control.
* Ensure on\-time launches across channels, flagging critical\-path risks early enough to course\-correct.
* Set pricing and margin architecture for the category – benchmark against competitors, protect intake and realised margins, and guide sourcing on cost targets.
* Partner with the design team on newness and hero products – translate commercial signals into clear briefs for gifting, festive, and collection drops.
* Shop the market and competitors – identify white spaces and bring sharp, well\-evidenced range recommendations.
* Drive category expansion – spot adjacent sub\-categories and gaps in tableware, textiles, décor, and gifting, and build the case to enter them.
* Partner with VM and retail so the Home story is told well in\-store and online, and build reports and dashboards that turn numbers into decisions.



**What You Bring Along** 



* 5–8 years in fashion, home, or lifestyle merchandising, with a minimum of 3 years handling the Home category.
* Very strong analytical ability, including proficient, hands\-on command of Excel / Google Sheets.
* Fluent with AI and digital tools, and quick to apply them – turning technology into sharper planning, cleaner communication, and building efficient dashboards and workflows.
* You understand what makes Home aesthetically and commercially different – sub\-categories with distinct end uses, buying rhythms and margin logic.
* Strong cross\-functional skills with design, sourcing, planning, VM, and retail, and disciplined follow\-through across multiple drops.



**The Nicobar Spark** 



* A natural problem\-solver – you break messy, ambiguous situations into clear parts, and you'd rather bring a solution than escalate a problem.
* Strong stakeholder management – you build trust quickly across design, sourcing, planning, and retail, and you know how to influence without authority.
* A clear communicator – you turn numbers into a story people can act on, whether you're in a leadership review or a design huddle.
* Calm under pressure – drops, deadlines, and last\-minute changes don't rattle you; you re\-prioritise and keep the critical path moving.
* Detail\-obsessed without losing the big picture – you sweat the SKU\-level numbers but never lose sight of the season and the brand.
* A builder, not just a doer – you leave behind better templates, cleaner reports, and sharper ways of working than you found.
* Genuinely collaborative – you share credit, ask good questions, and make the people around you better.
* Commercially curious – you keep asking "why" behind the numbers and "what next" for the category.

title: Manager, APAC Client Risk
description:
**Proceed with Pride** 
 is Bain’s client selection and acceptance process. Developed in partnership with our Industry and Capability Practice Areas, it helps ensure we can be proud of the work we take on. When concerns arise, Partners are encouraged to engage the Proceed with Pride team for guidance and discussion.
   

  

 The focus is nearly always on identifying the right mitigating actions to enable us to Proceed with Pride, although in some instances we will jointly decide not to proceed.
   

  

 Regional Risk Officers (RROs) have been appointed to lead Regional Risk teams to align Proceed with Pride more closely with our line leadership. RROs are experienced, independent Advisory Partners and report to our
 **Chief Risk Officer** 
 , who reports to the Board Risk Sub\-Committee.
   

  

 In this role, you will support the
 **Senior Manager, APAC Client Risk** 
 , and the
 **APAC RRO** 
 , helping to shape and execute the region’s approach to client selection and acceptance. You’ll be a key driver of strategic thinking and operational execution across risk efforts in the region.
   

  

**Why you’ll want to join**
* Work at the intersection of ethics, reputation, and real\-world events: Apply critical thinking to complex topics (e.g., geopolitics, regulatory scrutiny, sensitive sectors, AI), and support senior decision\-making on whether and how Bain engages with clients and different types of work, balancing ethical and reputational trade\-offs with integrity, while protecting Bain’s values and enabling responsible growth.
* Build a critical capability for Bain’s future: Proceed with Pride is a growing, evolving function – help shape how we manage emerging risk issues, expand our scope, and modernise how we operate at scale.
* Direct exposure to senior leadership: Collaborate with Partners, Office Heads, Practice leaders, Legal, and PR/Comms, and support engagements with EMEA’s Regional Managing Partner (RMP) and Bain’s Board Risk Sub\-Committee.
* Have fun! Proceed with Pride is global, yet close\-knit – be part of a collaborative and supportive team with a meaningful mission, a strong culture of camaraderie and plenty of opportunities for professional growth.


**Key tasks**
* APAC Client Selection and Acceptance Process – Lead and manage end\-to\-end risk assessments
* Monitor the APAC opportunity pipeline to identify ‘higher risk’ cases flagged by risk guidelines, including work in regulated and reputationally sensitive sectors (e.g., gambling, sensitive areas of healthcare).
* Confirm assessment requirements with Partners and facilitate in\-depth discussions on client context and strategy, reputational considerations, and risk trade\-offs.
* Conduct relevant research, frame key questions, and coordinate input from Legal, PR, and other internal experts.
* Summarise decisions and mitigation plans, monitor implementation, and evaluate outcomes to protect Bain’s reputation and enable responsible growth.
* Risk Awareness, Education \& Engagement – Build and sustain a culture of risk mindfulness
* Own and produce reporting on client risk and reputational themes across APAC, highlighting strategic implications and emerging external drivers.
* Design and develop briefing materials and coordinate leadership updates for senior stakeholders (including APAC leadership and Practice Area Heads), strengthening Partners’ awareness of their role in client risk and reputation management for Bain.
* Design agendas and run regular sessions with Practice Area Managers (PAMs) to build awareness, surface risks, and strengthen risk capabilities across teams, supporting consistent decision\-making across the region.
* Team Enablement \& Innovation – Strengthen the Proceed with Pride team through scalable, forward\-thinking solutions
* Support initiatives to build and evolve the team’s purpose and mission, including leveraging AI to automate processes and improve insight generation.
* Continuously refine frameworks and guidelines to remain effective in an ever\-changing, volatile environment, reflecting evolving reputational expectations and strategic priorities.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve team efficiency, collaboration, and impact through innovative tools and approaches, enabling faster, higher\-quality decisions.


**About You**
**Experience \& Skills**
* 3\-6 years of professional experience in consulting, legal, audit, risk, or a similar field.
* Passion for governance and ethics, and for helping Bain decide which work to take on – strategically, reputationally, and responsibly – ensuring we can Proceed with Pride.
* Strong analytical skills; ability to synthesise complex information and anticipate risks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, especially with senior leaders.
* Strong understanding of current affairs and geopolitical dynamics, and their implications for client strategy and reputational risk.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.


**Personal Attributes**
* Collaborative: Works effectively across teams and functions. Service\-focused.
* Organised \& Detail\-Oriented: Keeps processes on track and ensures accuracy.
* Pragmatic: Strong problem\-solving ability with a practical sense of what’s achievable.
* Articulate: Communicates clearly and with impact – both verbally and in writing.
* Team player: Passionate, reliable, and great to work with.
* Tech\-savvy: Open to using AI tools and embracing new technologies with a growth mindset.

If you share our vision, we’d love to have you onboard.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Trade Operations Manager to oversee the end\-to\-end trade operations process and ensure accurate, timely, and efficient processing of trading activities. The role will work closely with Trading, RMS, Technology, Finance, Brokers, and Exchanges.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Monitor operational risks and ensure compliance with internal policies and applicable market requirements.
* Lead and mentor the RMS and Trade Analyst team and ensure effective allocation of responsibilities.

* Oversee trade capture, confirmation, reconciliation, settlement, and exception management.
* Monitor daily trades, positions, P\&L, margins, and settlement obligations.
* Identify and resolve trade breaks, mismatches, failed settlements, and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with exchanges, clearing members, banks, and internal teams for trade\-related issues.
* Ensure timely completion of daily operational and settlement activities.
* Establish and maintain strong operational controls and processes.
* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and management\-level operational reports.
* Work with Technology teams to improve trade\-processing systems and automate manual processes.
* Drive process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency.



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* 6\+ years of experience in Trade Operations, Capital Markets Operations, Brokerage, Investment Banking, or a related financial\-services function.
* Strong understanding of equities, futures, options, trade lifecycle, reconciliation, and settlement processes.
* Experience in the MCX market is an added advantage.
* Experience working with brokers, exchanges, clearing corporations, and custodians.
* Good knowledge of operational controls, risk management, and exception handling.
* Strong Excel skills; knowledge of SQL/Python and automation is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage teams and work effectively in a fast\-paced trading environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline; MBA/CFA/FRM is an advantage.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience in a proprietary trading firm, HFT firm, hedge fund, brokerage, exchange, or financial technology company.
* Exposure to automated/systematic trading environments.
* Experience implementing operational automation and process improvements.

title: Operations Manager – Air & Sea Freight Forwarding | Import & Export | End-to-End Operations
description:
JOB TITLE: Operations Manager – Freight Forwarding (Air \& Sea)
 



  





 LOCATION: Gurgaon
 



 EXPERIENCE: 7–12\+ Years
 



 INDUSTRY: Freight Forwarding / Logistics / International Freight
 



  





 POSITION OVERVIEW
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager who can independently manage the complete freight forwarding operations across Air Freight and Sea Freight – Import \& Export.
 



  





 The candidate must have strong hands\-on knowledge of end\-to\-end shipment operations, pricing, costing, carrier/vendor coordination, documentation, customs coordination, transportation, customer handling, team management and operational profitability.
 



  





 This is a senior operational role. The candidate should understand not only how to execute shipments but also what every shipment costs, how it should be priced, where the margin is made or lost, and how the complete operation is controlled from booking to final delivery and billing.
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. END\-TO\-END FREIGHT OPERATIONS
 



  





 • Manage complete Air and Sea Freight operations from booking to final delivery.
 



 • Handle Import and Export shipments.
 



 • Manage FCL and LCL shipments.
 



 • Coordinate with customers, airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs, co\-loaders, overseas agents, CHAs, transporters, CFSs and warehouses.
 



 • Monitor shipment milestones and ensure timely movement.
 



 • Resolve operational issues and escalations proactively.
 



  





 2\. AIR FREIGHT OPERATIONS
 



  





 • Manage Air Import and Export shipments.
 



 • Airline booking and rate coordination.
 



 • Handle AWB, HAWB and MAWB.
 



 • Manage flight schedules, cut\-offs and cargo acceptance.
 



 • Handle pre\-alerts and documentation.
 



 • Track shipments and provide timely status updates.
 



 • Handle flight cancellations, rollovers, offloads, delays and re\-bookings.
 



 • Coordinate with airlines and handling agents.
 



  





 3\. SEA FREIGHT OPERATIONS
 



  





 • Manage Sea Import and Export operations.
 



 • Handle FCL and LCL shipments.
 



 • Coordinate with shipping lines, NVOCCs and co\-loaders.
 



 • Handle MBL and HBL.
 



 • Manage booking confirmation and vessel schedules.
 



 • Handle Shipping Instructions (SI) and VGM.
 



 • Coordinate container allocation, pickup, stuffing and gate\-in.
 



 • Check BL drafts and manage amendments.
 



 • Handle transshipment coordination.
 



 • Manage Arrival Notice, Delivery Order and final delivery.
 



 • Control detention, demurrage and free\-day issues.
 



  





 4\. PRICING, COSTING \& COMMERCIAL CONTROL
 



  





 • Understand Air Freight and Sea Freight buy and sell rates.
 



 • Obtain and negotiate rates with airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs and vendors.
 



 • Calculate complete shipment costs before quoting.
 



 • Understand origin and destination charges.
 



 • Manage THC, CFS, documentation, handling, carting, transportation and other applicable charges.
 



 • Calculate selling price and expected gross margin.
 



 • Identify cost leakages and unnecessary expenses.
 



 • Coordinate with the sales/commercial team for accurate quotations.
 



 • Verify vendor invoices against agreed rates.
 



 • Ensure correct customer billing and recovery of operational charges.
 



  





 5\. CUSTOMS \& CLEARANCE COORDINATION
 



  





 • Coordinate with CHAs and customs clearance teams.
 



 • Understand the complete Import and Export customs process.
 



 • Working knowledge of Shipping Bill, Bill of Entry, ICEGATE, examination, assessment, LEO and OOC processes.
 



 • Resolve customs queries and documentation discrepancies.
 



 • Ensure timely customs clearance and delivery.
 



 • Monitor shipments under customs hold or examination.
 



  





 6\. DOCUMENTATION
 



  





 The candidate should have strong knowledge of:
 



  





 • Commercial Invoice
 



 • Packing List
 



 • AWB / HAWB / MAWB
 



 • HBL / MBL
 



 • Shipping Bill
 



 • Bill of Entry
 



 • Shipping Instructions
 



 • VGM
 



 • Certificate of Origin
 



 • Delivery Order
 



 • Arrival Notice
 



 • Pre\-alerts
 



 • Insurance and shipment\-specific documents
 



  





 7\. VENDOR \& CARRIER MANAGEMENT
 



  





 • Maintain strong relationships with airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs, co\-loaders, transporters, CHAs, CFSs and warehouses.
 



 • Negotiate operational rates and service terms.
 



 • Monitor vendor performance.
 



 • Resolve rate disputes and service failures.
 



 • Ensure vendors work according to agreed commercial and operational terms.
 



  





 8\. TEAM MANAGEMENT
 



  





 • Lead and manage the Air and Sea Operations team.
 



 • Allocate shipments and responsibilities.
 



 • Monitor daily operational performance.
 



 • Establish and implement SOPs.
 



 • Train team members on operational procedures.
 



 • Coordinate between Operations, Sales, Documentation, Accounts and Customer Service.
 



 • Handle critical operational escalations.
 



  





 9\. CUSTOMER \& ESCALATION MANAGEMENT
 



  





 • Act as the senior operational point of contact for key customers.
 



 • Handle customer escalations related to delays, documentation, rates, clearance and delivery.
 



 • Provide accurate shipment updates.
 



 • Ensure service commitments are met.
 



 • Maintain strong customer relationships through reliable operational execution.
 



  





 10\. OPERATIONAL MIS \& CONTROL
 



  





 • Maintain shipment\-wise operational records.
 



 • Track shipment status and pending actions.
 



 • Monitor operational costs and revenue.
 



 • Track detention, demurrage and additional costs.
 



 • Review vendor bills and customer billing.
 



 • Prepare operational MIS and management reports.
 



 • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
 



  





 MUST\-HAVE REQUIREMENTS
 



  





 • 7–12\+ years of experience in Freight Forwarding / International Logistics.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience in Air and Sea Freight Operations.
 



 • Experience in both Import and Export.
 



 • Strong knowledge of FCL, LCL and Air Freight.
 



 • Strong understanding of freight rates, costing and margins.
 



 • Good knowledge of customs clearance and CHA coordination.
 



 • Strong documentation knowledge.
 



 • Experience dealing with airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs and logistics vendors.
 



 • Strong vendor negotiation and management skills.
 



 • Experience managing an operations team.
 



 • Strong problem\-solving and escalation\-management skills.
 



 • Good understanding of the commercial and financial aspects of freight forwarding.
 



  





 CRITICAL REQUIREMENT
 



  





 The candidate must be capable of independently explaining a complete Air Export and Sea Import shipment process from booking to final delivery, including:
 



  





 • Operational process
 



 • Documentation
 



 • Parties involved
 



 • Freight and local charges
 



 • Vendor coordination
 



 • Customs process
 



 • Potential operational problems
 



 • Customer billing
 



 • Cost calculation
 



 • Margin calculation
 



  




* The candidate must have practical, end\-to\-end Freight Forwarding knowledge and should be capable of independently taking ownership of the complete Air \& Sea Operations function.
